g4520.definition: σαββατισμός , -οῦ, ὁ (σαββατίζω, to keep the sabbath, Exo.16:30 , al.), a keeping sabbath, a sabbath rest : metaphorically, as in Mishna (Zorell, see word), Heb.4:9. † (AS)

g4521.definition: σάββατον , -ου, τό (Aram. שַׁבָּתָא, transliterated σάββατα, and this being mistaken for a pl., the sing. σάββατον was formed from it), and σάββατα, -ων, τά [in LXX for שַׁבָּת, שַׁבָּתוֹן ;] __1. the seventh day of the week, the sabbath __(a) the sing. form -ον, τὸ σ.: Mat.12:8 , Mrk.2:27 , Luk.6:5 , al.; ἡ ἡμέρα τοῦ…

g4522.definition: σαγήνη , -ης, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for חֵרֶם ;] a drag-net, seine : Mat.13:47. † SYN. : ἀμφίβληστρον (which see), δίκτυον (AS)

g4526.definition: σάκκος also written σάκος, -ου, ὁ (cf. Heb. שַׂק, which it renders in LXX), __1. a coarse cloth, sackcloth, usually made of hair : Rev.6:12. __2. Anything made of sackcloth ; __(a) a sack ( Gen.42:25 , al.); __(b) a garment of sackcloth, expressive of mourning or penitence : Mat.11:21 , Luk.10:13 , Rev.11:3 .† (AS)

g4527.definition: Σαλά , ὁ indecl. (Heb. שֶׁלַח), Sala, Shalah : Luk.3:32 (R, txt., Σαλμών, which see), Luk.3:35. † (AS)

g4528.definition: Σαλαθιήλ , ὁ indecl. (Heb. שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵל), Salathiel : Mat.1:12 , Luk.3:27 .† (AS)

g4529.definition: Σαλαμίς , -ῖνσς, ἡ Salamis, the chief city of Cyprus : Act.13:5. † (AS)

g4530.definition: Σαλείμ , τό indecl., Salim : Jhn.3:23 (see Westc., in l; DB , iii, 354).† (AS)

g4531.definition: σαλεύω (σάλος), [in LXX for מוֹט, זוּעַ, etc. ;] prop., of the action of wind, storm, etc., to agitate, shake : of a reed, Mat.11:7 , Luk.7:24 ; a house, Luk.6:48 , Act.4:31 16:26 ; the earth, Heb.12:26; the heavenly bodies, Mat.24:29 , Mrk.13:25 , Luk.21:26 ; of a vessel shaken in filling, Luk.6:38. Metaphorical…

g4532.definition: Σαλήμ , ἡ (Heb. שָׁלֵם Gen.14:18 ), Salem : Heb.7:1-2 (LXX).† (AS)

g4533.definition: Σαλμών , ὁ indecl. (Heb. שַׂלְמוֹן), Salmon : Mat.1:4-5 , Luk.3:32 (Σαλά, WH, R, mg.).† (AS)

g4534.definition: Σαλμώνη , -ης, ἡ Salmone, a promontory of Crete : Act.27:7. † (AS)

g4536.definition: σάλπιγξ , -ιγγος, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for שׁוֹפָר, חֲצֹצְרָה ;] a trumpet, used in war and in religious ceremonies : 1Co.14:8 , Heb.12:19 , Rev.1:10 4:1 8:2, 6 8:11 9:14 By meton., a trumpet blast : μετὰ σ. μεγάλης, Mat.24:31; ἐν σ. θεοῦ, 1Th.4:16; ἐν τ. ἐσχάτῃ σ., 1Co.15:52. † (AS)

g4537.definition: σαλπίζω [in LXX chiefly for תָּקַע ;] to sound a trumpet : Rev.8:6 ff. Rev.9:1, 13 10:7 11:15 ; metaphorically, Mat.6:2. Impers., the trumpet sounds : 1Co.15:52. † (AS)

g4538.definition: σαλπιστής (so Inscr. and late writers for Mt. σαλπιγκτής), οῦ, ὁ, a trumpeter : Rev.18:22. † (AS)

g4540.definition: Σαμαρία (Rec. -άρεια), -ας, ἡ (Heb. שֹׁמְרוֹן; Aram. שָׁמְרַיִן), Samaria ; __(a) the city : Act.8:5 (and perhaps also Act.8:9, 14 ); __(b) the region : Luk.17:11 , Jhn.4:4-5 , 7, Act.1:8 8:1 (and perhaps also Act.8:9, 14 ) Act.9:31 15:3 .† (AS)

g4541.definition: Σαμαρείτης (-ίτης, Τ; see WH, App. , 154; BI., § 3, 4), -ον, ό, a Samaritan, i.e. an inhabitant of the city or the region of Samaria, in NT always the latter (see: Σαμαρία): Mat.10:5 , Luk.9:52 10:33 17:16 , Jhn.4:9, 39-40 , Act.8:25 ; as an opprobrious epithet, Jhn.8:48. † (AS)

g4543.definition: Σαμοθρᾴκη (-θράκη, BE), -ης, ἡ Samothrace, an island in the Ægean : Act.16:11. † (AS)

g4544.definition: Σάμος , -ου, ἡ Samos, an island in the Ægean : Act.20:15. † (AS)

g4545.definition: Σαμουήλ , ὁ indecl. (in FlJ, Σαμούηλος; Heb. שְׁמוּאֵל), Samuel ( 1Ki.1:20 , al.): Act.3:24 13:20 , Heb.11:32 .† (AS)

g4546.definition: Σαμψών , ὁ indecl. (Heb. שִׁמְשׁוֹן), Samson ( Jdg.13:1-25 ff.): Heb.11:32 .† (AS)

g4547.definition: σανδάλιον , -ου, τό (dimin. of σάνδαλον, prob. Persian), [in LXX: Jos.9:5 , Isa.20:2 (נָעַל, elsewhere rendered ὑπόδημα, which see), Jdth.10:4 16:9 * ;] a sandal : Mrk.6:9 , Act.12:8 .† (AS)

g4548.definition: σανίς , -ίδος, ἡ [in LXX: Sng.8:9 , Eze.27:5 (לוּחַ) * ;] a board, plank : Act.27:44 (AS)

g4549.definition: Σαούλ , ὁ indecl. (in FlJ, Σάουλος; Heb. שָׁאוּל) Saul ; __(a) the King of Israel : Act.13:21; __(b) the Jewish name of the Apostle Paul, used in the indecl. form only in address (cf. Σαῦλος): Act.9:4, 17 22:7, 13 26:14 .† (AS)

g4550.definition: σαπρός , -ά -όν [in Sm.: Lev.27:14, 33 * ;] rotten, corrupt, bad, worth­less : of trees and fruit (opposite to ἀγαθός, καλός), Mat.7:17-18 12:33 Luk.6:43 ; of fish, Mat.13:48. Metaphorical, in moral sense: λόγος σ., Eph.4:29. "In Hellenistic . . . it became a synonym for αἰσχρός or κακός," MM, xxii.† (AS)

g4551.definition: Σαπφείρα , -ης (see B1., § 3, 4), ἡ (Aram. שַׁפִּירָא) Sapphia : Act.5:1. † (AS)

g4552.definition: σάπφειρος , -ου, ἡ [in LXX for סַפִּיר ;] sapphire (perh. = lapis lazuli): Rev.21:19. † (AS)

g4553.definition: σαργάνη , -ης, ἡ __1. a plaited rope (Æsch.). __2. a hamper, a basket made of ropes : 2Co.11:33. † (AS)

g4554.definition: Σάρδεις , -εων, αἱ Sardis, the chief city of Lydia : Rev.1:11 3:1, 4 (AS)

g4556.definition: σάρδιον , -ον, τ [in LXX for אֹדֶם, Exo.28:17 , al.; also for שֹׁהַם ;] the sardian stone, sard (of which carnelian is one variety): Rev.4:3 21:20 .† (AS)

g4557.definition: σαρδόνυξ (L, σαρδιόνυξ), -υχος, ὁ (σάρδιον, ὄνυξ), sardonyx, a stone marked by the red of the sard and the white of the onyx : Rev.21:20. † (AS)

g4558.definition: Σάρεπτα , -ων (Ob 20), τά (Heb. צָרְפַת), Sarepta, a city of Sidon : Luk.4:26. † (AS)

g4559.definition: σαρκικός , -ή, -όν (σάρξ) (seel. for σάρκινος, Arist., H.A., x, 2, 7) = Lat. carnalis, i.e. __(a) associated with or pertaining to the flesh, fleshly, carnal : Rom.15:27 , 1Co.9:11 ; __(b) in a more ethical sense, of the nature of the flesh, under the control of its appetites, fleshly, carnal, sensual (but including…

g4560.definition: σάρκινος , -η, -ον (σάρξ), [in LXX: 2Ch.32:8 , Eze.11:19 36:26 (בָּשָׂר), Est.4:17 , Pro.24:23 ( Pro.29:27 ) * ;] = Lat. carneus (the termination -ινος denoting the substance or material of a thing; see Tr., Syn. , § LXXii; Lft., Notes , 184; and for illustrations from π., see MM, xxii), of the flesh, of flesh, fleshy…

g4561.definition: σάρξ , σαρκός, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for בָּשָׂר ;] flesh ; __1. as in cl. generally, __(a) prop., of the soft substance of the animal body: 1Co.15:39 , 2Co.12:7 , Gal.6:13 , al.; σ. καὶ αἷμα, 1Co.5:50; σ. καὶ ὀστέα, Luk.24:39; pl., of the flesh of many or parts of the flesh of one (cl.), Rev.17:16 19:18 ; φαγεῖν, Re, ll.…

g4562.definition: Σερούχ (Rec. Σαρ-), ὁ, indecl. (Heb. שְׂרוּג), Serug : Luk.3:35. † (AS)

g4563.definition: σαρόω , -ῶ late form of σαίρω, to sweep : with accusative, Luk.15:8; pass., Mat.12:44 , Luk.11:25 .† (AS)

g4564.definition: Σάρρα , -ας, ἡ (Heb. שָׂרָה, Gen.17:15 ), Sarah : Rom.4:19 9:9 , Heb.11:11 , 1Pe.3:6 .† (AS)

g4565.definition: Σάρων , -ωνος (accusative -ῶνα, WH), ὁ (Heb. שָׁרוֹן), the plain of Sharon : Act.9:35. † (AS)

g4567.definition: Σατανᾶς , -ᾶ (so also Sir 21:30 , but in 3Ki.11:14 , σατάν indecl.; Heb. שָׂטָן; Aram. סָטָנָא, whence the inflected Gk. form), ό, Satan (i.e. the adversary, as in LXX, ll. with): Mat.4:10 12:26 , Mrk.1:13 3:23, 26 4:15 Luk.10:18 11:18 13:16 22:3, 31 , Jhn.13:27 , Act.5:3 26:18 , Rom.16:20 , 1Co.5:5 7:5 , 2Co.2:11…

g4568.definition: σάτον , -ου, τό (Aram. סָאתָא = Heb. סְאָה), [in LXX: Hag.2:17 (16)* ;] a Hebrew measure (= about a peck and a half): Mat.13:33 , Luk.13:21 .† (AS)

g4569.definition: Σαῦλος , -ου, ὁ (Hellenized form of Σαούλ, which see), Saul, the Jewish name of the Apostle Paul : Act.7:58 8:1, 3 9:1, 8 9:11, 22 9:24 11:25, 30 12:25 13:1-2, 7 13:9 .† (AS)

g4570.definition: σβέννυμι [in LXX chiefly for כָּבָה ;] of fire or things on fire, to quench : with accusative, Mat.12:20 , Eph.6:16 , Heb.11:34 ; pass., Mat.25:8 , Mrk.9:48 , [44, 46]. Metaphorical (cf. Sng.8:7 , 4Ma.16:4 ): τὸ πνεῦμα, 1Th.5:19. † ζβέννυμι, for σβ-, 1Th.5:19 T (see WH, Notes , 148).† (AS)

g4574.definition: σέβασμα , -τος, τό (σεβάζομαι), [in LXX: Wis.14:20 15:17 , Da TH Bel 1:27 * ;] an object of worship : Act.17:23 , 2Th.2:4 .† (AS)

g4576.definition: σέβω [in LXX (chiefly for יָרֵא, Jos.4:24 , al.) and NT always mid., σέβομαι, exc. 4Ma.5:24 ;] to worship : with accusative of person(s), Mat.15:9 , Mrk.7:7 , Act.18:13 19:27 ; σεβόμενος τ. θεόν, Act.16:14 18:7 ; σεβόμενοι (σ. προσήλυτοι, σ. Ἕλληνες), devout, Act.13:43, 50 17:4, 17 (cf. προσήλυτος).† (AS)

g4577.definition: σειρά , -ᾶς, ἡ [in LXX: Jdg.16:13-14, 19 (מַחְלָפָה), Pro.5:22 (חֶבֶל) * ;] __1. (a) a cord; __(b) a chain (cf. Pr. , l.with): σειραὶ ζόφου, 2Pe.2:4 , Rec., R, mg. (see: σειρός). __2. a lock of hair (Jg, ll. with).† (AS)

g4578.definition: σεισμός , -οῦ, ὁ (σείω), [in LXX chiefly for רַעַשׁ ;] a shaking, commotion, as a tempest at sea : Mat.8:24; esp. an earthquake: Mat.24:7 27:54 28:2 , Mrk.13:8 , Luk.21:11 , Act.16:26 , Rev.6:12 8:5 11:13, 19 16:18 .† (AS)

g4579.definition: σείω [in LXX chiefly for רָעַשׁ ;] to shake, move to and fro : τ. γῆν, Heb.12:26 (LXX); pass., ἡ γῆ, Mat.27:51 (LXX); συκῆ, Rev.6:13. Metaphorical, to agitate, stir up, with fear or some other emotion : Mat.21:10 28:4 (cf. ἀνα-, δια-, κατα-σείω).† (AS)

g4581.definition: Σελευκία (Rec. -εύκεια), Seleucia, a city of Syria : Act.13:4. † (AS)

g4582.definition: σελήνη , -ης, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for יָרֵחַ ( Gen.37:9 , al.), also for לְבָנָה; ( Sng.6:9 (10), ? Isa.24:23 30:26 ) ;] the moon : Mat.24:29 , Mrk.13:24 , Luk.21:25 , Act.2:20 " (LXX), 1Co.15:41 , Rev.6:12 8:12 12:1 21:23 .† (AS)

g4583.definition: σεληνιάζω (σελήνη), act, in Manetho (Caren., 4, 81), in NT depon. -ομαι, to be moonstruck, i.e. epileptic (epilepsy being supposed to be influenced by the moon): Mat.4:24 17:15 .† (AS)

g4584.definition: Σεμεείν (Rec. Σεμεΐ), ὁ, indecl., Semein : Luk.3:26. † (AS)

g4585.definition: σεμίδαλις , -εως, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for סֹלֶת ;] fine wheaten flour : Rev.18:13. † (AS)

g4586.definition: σεμνός , -ή, -όν (σέβομαι), [in LXX: Pro.6:8 8:6 15:26 , 2Ma.6:11 2Mac 6:28 2Mac 8:15 , 4Ma.5:36 4Mac 7:15 4Mac 17:5 * ;] __1. reverend, august, venerable, in cl. of the gods and also of human beings. __2. grave, serious; of persons : 1Ti.3:8 3:11 , Tit.2:2 ; of things: Php.4:8 (see Tr., Syn. , § xcii; Cremer, 37; MM…

g4588.definition: Σέργιος , -ου, ὁ Sergius, surnamed Paulus : Act.13:7. † (AS)

g4589.definition: Σήθ , ὁ (Heb. שֵׁת), indecl., Seth ( Gen.4:25 ): Luk.3:38 .† (AS)

g4590.definition: Σήμ , ὁ indecl. (Heb. שֵׁם), Shem : Luk.3:36. † (AS)

g4591.definition: σημαίνω (σῆμα, a sign), [in LXX for רוּעַ hi., תָּקַע, etc. ;] to give a sign, signify, indicate : with accusative of thing(s), Act.25:27 , Rev.1:1 (cf. MM, xxii); with accusative and inf., Act.11:28; before quæst. indir., Jhn.12:33 18:32 21:19 .† (AS)

g4592.definition: σημεῖον , -ου, τό [in LXX chiefly for אוֹת ;] a sign, mark, token ; __(a) of that which distinguishes a person or thing from others : Mat.26:48 Luk.2:12 , 2Th.3:17 (cf. Deiss., LAE , 153.2); before genitive epexeg., Rom.4:11; with genitive obj., Mat.24:8, 30 , 2Co.12:12 ; with genitive subj., Mat.16:3; __(b) a sign of…

g4593.definition: σημειόω , -ῶ (σημεῖον), [in LXX: Psa.4:6 (נָשָׂא)* ;] to mark, note. Mid., to note for oneself : 2Th.3:14 (frequently in π.; see ICC , M, Th. , in l).† (AS)

g4594.definition: σήμερον (Att.. τήμερον), adv. , [in LXX for יוֹם ;] to-day : Mat.6:11 , Luk.4:21 , Act.4:9 , al.; opposite to αὔριον, Mat.6:30 , Luk.12:28 , Jas.4:13 ; χθὲς καὶ σ. καὶ εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας, Heb.13:8; ἡ σ. ἡμέρα, Act.20:20; ἕως (ἄχρι) τῆς σ. ἡμέρας, Rom.11:8 , 2Co.3:14 ; μέχρι (ἕως) τῆς σ. (sc. ἡμέρας), Mat.11:23 27:8 ; as…

g4596.definition: σιρικός (by assimilation of vowels, for σηρικός; see Mayser, 150; WH, Notes , 151), -ή, -όν (οἱ Σῆρες, a people of India from whom the ancients got the first silk), silk, silken ; as subst., τὸ σ., silken fabric, silk : Rev.18:12 (cf. FlJ, B.J., vii, 5, 4).† (AS)

g4597.definition: σής σητός (late genitive for cl. σεός), ὁ, [in LXX: Job.4:19 , Isa.50:9 (עָשׁ), Isa.51:8 (סָס), al. ;] a moth, clothes moth : Mat.6:19-20 , Luk.12:33 .† (AS)

g4598.definition: σητό-βρωτος , -ον (οής, βιβρώσκω), [in LXX: Job.13:28 (אָכַל עָשׁ) * ;] moth-eaten : Jas.5:2. † (AS)

g4599.definition: σθενόω , -ῶ (σθένος, strength), to strengthen : with accusative, 1Pe.5:10 (Hesych.).† (AS)

g4600.definition: σιαγών , -όνος, ἡ [in LXX for לְחִי ;] the jawbone, jaw, cheek : Mat.5:39 , Luk.6:29 (cf. MM, xxii).† (AS)

g4601.definition: σιγάω , -ῶ (σιγή), [in LXX for חָרַשׁ, חָשָׁה, etc. ;] __1. intrans., to be silent, keep silence : Luk.9:36 18:39 20:26 , Act.12:17 15:12-13 , 1Co.14:28 14:30 14:34 . __2. Trans., to keep secret; pass., to be kept secret : Rom.16:25. † SYN. : ἡσυχάζω, σιωπάω (AS)

g4602.definition: σιγή , -ῆς, ἡ [in LXX: Wis.18:14 , 3Ma.3:23 * ;] silence : Act.21:40 , Rev.8:1 .† (AS)

g4603.definition: σιδήρεος , -α, -ον (-οῦς, -ᾶ -οῦν) (σίδηρος), [in LXX chiefly for בַּרְזֶל ;] of iron : Act.12:10 , Rev.2:27 9:9 12:5 19:15 .† (AS)

g4604.definition: σίδηρος , -ου, ὁ [in LXX chiefly for בַּרְזֶל ;] iron : Rev.18:12. † (AS)

g4605.definition: Σιδών , -ῶnος, ἡ (Heb. צִידוֹן), Sidon, a maritime city of Phœnicia : Mat.11:21-22 15:21 , Mrk.3:8 7:24, 31 , Luk.6:17 10:13-14 , Act.27:3 .† (AS)

g4606.definition: Σιδώνιος , -α, -ον (Σιδών), of Sidon, Sidonian ; __(a) the region : sc. χώρα, Luk.4:26; __(b) the people : Act.12:20. † (AS)

g4607.definition: σικάριος , -ου, ὁ (Lat.; sica, a dagger carried under their clothing by the Sicarii), a bandit, assassin, one of the Sicarii (FlJ, B.J., ii, 17, 6, al.): Act.21:38. † (AS)

g4609.definition: Σίλας , -α (accusative to BL, § 29, W-Schm., 74, -ᾶς, -ᾶ), ὁ (Aram. שׁאִילָא; see Dalman, Gr. , 157.5), Silas (called also Σιλουανός, which see): Act.15:22, 27 15:32, 34 15:40 16:19, 25 16:29 17:4, 10 17:14-15 18:5 † (AS)

g4610.definition: Σιλουανός (in MSS also Σιλβανός, a form frequently in π.), -οῦ, ὁ, Silvanus, latinized name of Silas : 2Co.1:19 , 1Th.1:1 , 2Th.1:1 , 1Pe.5:12 .† (AS)

g4611.definition: Σιλωάμ (indecl., but in FlJ, genitive, ᾶ, B.J., ii, 16, 2), ὁ (Heb. שִׁלֹחַ), Siloam (see DB , iii, 515 f.): Luk.13:4 , Jhn.9:7, 11 .† (AS)

g4612.definition: σιμικίνθιον (also written σημι-), -ου, τό (Lat. semicinctium), a work­man's apron : Act.19:12. † (AS)

g4613.definition: Σίμων , -ωνος, ὁ a Greek name (transliterated סִימוֺן in Heb. ) used as a substitute for Συμεών (which see), Simon __1. Simon Peter : Mat.17:25 , Mrk.1:29 , al. __2. Simon the Zealot (see: ζηλωτής, Καναναῖος): Mat.10:4 , Mrk.3:18 , Luk.6:15 , Act.1:13 . __3. One of the Brethren of our Lord (see: ἀδελψός): Mat.13:55…

g4614.definition: Σινά (-ᾶ, Rec.), indecl. (but τὸ Σιναῖον, FlJ, Ant. , iii, 5, 1; τὸ Σιναῖον ὄρος, ib. ii, 12, 1), τό (Heb. סִינַי), Sinai ( Exo.19:11 , al.): Act.7:30, 38 , Gal.4:24-25 † (AS)

g4615.definition: σίναπι , -εως, τό (prob. Egyptian), = Attic τὸ νᾶπυ mustard : Mat.13:31 17:20 , Mrk.4:31 , Luk.13:19 17:6 .† (AS)

g4616.definition: σινδών , -όνος, ἡ [in LXX: Jdg.14:12-13 A, Pro.31:24 (סָדִין), 1Ma.10:64 A * ;] fine linen cloth ; __(a) as used for swathing dead bodies (cf. Hdt., ii, 86): Mat.27:59 , Mrk.15:46 , Luk.23:53 ; __(b) a garment or wrap of this material (cf. ICC , Jg, l.with): Mrk.14:51-52. † (AS)

g4617.definition: σινιάω (σίνιον, a sieve), = σήθω, to sift, winnow : figuratively, Luk.22:31. † (AS)

g4620.definition: σιτομέτριον , -ου, τό (σιτομετρέω, Gen.47:12, 14 *, = Attic τὸν σῖτον μετρέω), a measured portion of food : Luk.12:42 (for exx. in π., see Deiss., BS, 158; LAE , 103.1).† (AS)

g4621.definition: σῖτος , -ου, ὁ [in LXX chiefly for דָּגָן ;] wheat, corn : Mat.3:12 13:25, 29-30 Mrk.4:28 , Luk.3:17 12:18 16:7 22:32 , Jhn.12:24 , Act.27:38 , 1Co.15:37 , Rev.6:6 18:13 .† σιτίοι, -ου, τό (dimin. of σῖτος), [in LXX: Pro.30:22 (לֶחֶם)* ;] __1. corn, grain : Act.7:12 (but see 131., § 9, 1). __2. Mostly in pl., σιτία…

g4622.definition: Σιών indecl., in NT anarth., but in LXX when used of the city of Jerusalem, ἡ Σ. (Heb. צִיּוֹן), Zion ; __1. the mountain : in typical sense, of the Church, Heb.12:22; of heaven, Rev.14:1. __2. The city, i.e. Jerusalem; in poetical sense; __(a) of the inhabitants : θυγάτηρ Σ, Mat.21:5 , Jhn.12:15 " (LXX) ; __(b) in…

g4623.definition: σιωπάω , -ῶ (σιωπή, silence) [in LXX for חָשָׁה, חָרַשׁ hi., etc. ;] to be silent or still, keep silence : Mat.20:31 26:63 , Mrk.3:4 9:34 10:48 14:61 , Luk.19:4 , Act.18:9 ; of one dumb, Luk.1:20 (cf. 4Ma.10:18 ); addressed rhetorically to the sea, σιώπα, Mrk.4:39. † SYN. : ἡσυχάζω, σιγάω (which see) (AS)

g4624.definition: σκανδαλίζω (σκάνδαλον), [in LXX: Dan LXX 11:41 (כָּשַׁל ni.), Sir.9:5 ( Sir.35:15 32:15 ) (יָקֹשׁ ho.) g4625.definition: σκάνδαλον , -ου, τό (late form of the rare word σκανδάληθρον, see LS, see word) [in LXX chiefly for מוֹקֵשׁ, מִכְשׁוֹל ;] prop., the bait-stick of a trap, a snare, stumbling-block ( Lev.19:14 , Jdth.5:1 ): figuratively, Rom.9:33 , 1Pe.2:8 ( Isa.8:14 ; aliter in LXX; στερεὸν σκανδάλου in Aq.). Metaphorical, of that…

g4626.definition: σκάπτω [in LXX: Isa.5:6 (עֲדַר ni.)* ;] to dig : Luk.6:48 13:8 16:3 .† (AS)

g4627.definition: σκάφη , -ης, ἡ (σκάπτω), [in LXX: Dan LXX Bel 1:32 , TH Bel 1:33 * ;] anything scooped out, esp. a light boat, skiff : Act.27:16, 30 27:32 .† (AS)

g4628.definition: σκέλος , -ους, τό [in LXX for רֶגֶל, etc. ;] the leg from the hip downwards : ? Jhn.19:3-33 † (AS)

g4631.definition: σκευή , -ῆς, ἡ [in LXX: 3Ma.5:45 R * ;] equipment, tackle : Act.27:19. † (AS)

g4632.definition: σκεῦος , -ους, τό [in LXX chiefly for כְּלִי ;] a vessel, implement (for exx. in various senses, see MM, xxii): Mrk.11:16 , Luk.8:16 , Jhn.19:29 , Act.10:11, 16 11:5 , Rom.9:21 , Rev.18:12 ; pl., 2Ti.2:20 , Rev.2:27 ; τὰ σ. τῆς λειτουργίας, Heb.9:21; pl., τὰ σ., utensils, goods, Mat.12:29 , Mrk.3:27 , Luk.17:31 ; id.…

g4633.definition: σκηνή , -ῆς, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for אֹהֶל, also for מִשְׁכָּן, סֻכָּה, etc. ;] a tent, booth, tabernacle : Mat.17:4 , Mrk.9:5 , Luk.9:33 , Heb.11:9 ; αἱ αἰώνιοι σ., Luk.16:9; of the Mosaic tabernacle, Heb.8:5 9:2-3, 6 9:8, 21 ; σ. τ. μαρτυρίου, Act.7:44; of its heavenly prototype, Heb.8:2 9:11 , Rev.13:6 15:5 21:3 ; of…

g4635.definition: σκηνοποιός , -όν (σκηνή, ποιέω), making tents ; as subst., ὁ σ., a tent-maker : Act.18:3. † (AS)

g4636.definition: σκῆνος , -ους, τό [in LXX: Wis.9:15 * ;] = σκηνή, a tent, tabernacle (C.1., 3071). Metaphorical, of the body as the tabernacle of the soul: 2Co.5:1 5:4 .† (AS)

g4637.definition: σκηνόω , -ῶ (σκηνή), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁכַן ;] to have one's tabernacle, to dwell (in π. of temporary dwelling, see MM, Exp. , xxii): before ἐπί, with accusative of person(s), Rev.7:15; before ἐν, with dative of person(s), Jhn.1:14; id. with dative loc., Rev.12:12 13:6 ; before μετά, with genitive of person(s)…

g4638.definition: σκήνωμα , -τος, τό (σκηνόω), [in LXX chiefly for אֹהֶל ;] a tent, tabernacle (cf. σκηνή, σκῆνος): of the temple as God's dwelling ( Psa.132:5 , al.), Act.7:46 . Metaphorical, of the body: 2Pe.1:13-14. † (AS)

g4639.definition: σκιά , -ᾶς, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for צֵל, 4Ki.20:9 ff., Psa.57:1 , al.; but σ. and σ. θανάτου are also used for צַלְמָוֶת, Job.3:5 , Psa.3:4 , Isa.9:2 (1) (see ICC , in l), al. ;] __1. shadow, shade, caused by interception of light : Mrk.4:32 , Act.5:15 ; metaphorically, σ. θανάτου, of ignorance and error, Mat.4:16…

g4640.definition: σκιρτάω , -ῶ [in LXX: Gen.25:22 (רָצַץ hithpo.), Psa.114:4 , 6 (רָקַד), etc. ;] to leap : Luk.1:41, 44 6:23 .† (AS)

g4641.definition: σκληρο-καρδία , -ας, ἡ (σκληρός, καρδία), [in LXX: Deu.10:16 , Jer.4:4 (לֵבָב עׇרְלָה), Sir.16:10 (cf. καρδία σκληρά, Sir.3:26-27 ) * ;] hardness of heart : Mat.19:8 , Mrk.10:5 16:14 .† (AS)

g4642.definition: σκληρός , -ά, -όν (σκέλλω, to dry), [in LXX chiefly for קָשָׁה ;] hard to the touch, rough, harsh, (opposite to μαλακός); metaphorically, in various uses; __(a) of men, hard, stern, severe : Mat.25:24; __(b) of things, hard, rough, violent : σκληρόν σοι (ἐστι), Act.26:14; λόγος, Jhn.6:60; ἄνεμος, Jas.3:4; σκληρὰ…

g4643.definition: σκληρότης , -ητος, ἡ (σκληρός), [in LXX: Deu.9:27 (קְשִׁי), etc. ;] hardness ; metaphorically, of stubbornness: Rom.2:5. † (AS)

g4644.definition: σκληρο-τράχηλος , -ον (σκληρός, τράχηλος), [in LXX: Exo.33:3 , 5 (עֹרֶף ־קָשֶׁה), etc. ;] stiff-necked : metaphorically, Act.7:51. † (AS)

g4645.definition: σκληρύνω (σκληρός), [in LXX chiefly for קָשָׁה hi., also for חָזַק ;] to harden. Metaphorical, to harden, make stubborn : with accusative of person(s), Rom.9:18; T. καρδίας ( Psa.95:8 ), Heb.3:8, 15 4:7 . Pass., to become hardened : Act.19:9 , Heb.3:13 .† (AS)

g4646.definition: σκολιός , -ά, -όν [in LXX: Deu.32:5 (עִקֵּשׁ), Pro.28:18 (σ. ὁδοῖς πορεύεσθαι, for: דֶּרֶךְ עָקַשׁ), Isa.40:4 (עָקֹב), etc. ;] curved, bent, winding (opposite to ὀρθός, εὐθύς): Luk.3:5 (LXX). Metaphorical, crooked, perverse, unjust : Act.2:40 , Php.2:15 , 1Pe.2:18 .† (AS)

g4647.definition: σκόλοψ , -οπος, ὁ [in LXX: Num.33:55 (שֵׂךְ), Hos.2:6 (8) (סִיר), Eze.28:24 (סִלּוֹן), Sir.43:19 * ;] anything pointed, esp. __1. in cl., a stake __2. In Hellenistic vernacular, a thorn (cf. LXX, ll. with): σ. τῇ σαρκί, 2Co.12:7 (cf. MM, i., xxiii; DB , iii, 700 f.; Deiss., St. Paul, 62 f.; Field, Notes , 187).† (AS)

g4648.definition: ακοπέω , -ῶ (σκοπός), [in LXX: Est.8:13 , 2Ma.4:5 * ;] to look at, behold, watch, contemplate. Metaphorical, to look to, consider : with accusative of thing(s), 2Co.4:13 , Php.2:4 ; with accusative of person(s), Rom.16:17 , Php.3:17 ; before μή, Luk.11:35; σεαυτόν, before μή (see M, Pr. , 192), Gal.6:1 (cf. ἐπι-…

g4649.definition: σκοπός , -οῦ, ὁ [in LXX chiefly for צָפָה ;] __1. a watcher, watchman ( Eze.3:17 , al.). __2. a mark on which to fix the eye ( Wis.5:12, 21 , al.). Metaphorical, of an aim or object: Php.3:14. † (AS)

g4650.definition: σκορπίζω [in LXX for פּוּץ hi., etc. ;] in vernac. and in Ion, and late writers for σκεδάννυμι (see MM, xxiii; Rutherford, NPhr. , 295), to scatter : ὁ λύκος, Jhn.10:12; ὁ μὴ συνάγων μετ᾽ ἐμοῦ σκορπίζει, Mat.12:30 , Luk.11:23 ; pass., before εἰς, with accusative loc., Jhn.16:32; of one who dispenses blessings, 2Co.9:9…

g4651.definition: σκορπίος , -ου, ὁ [in LXX for עַקְרָב ;] a scorpion : Luk.10:19 11:12 , Rev.9:3, 5 9:10 † (AS)

g4652.definition: σκοτεινός (WH. -τινός) , -ή, -όν (σκότος), [in LXX chiefly for חֹשֶׁךְ and cogn. forms ;] dark : opposite to φωτεινός, Mat.6:23 , Luk.11:34, 36 .† (AS)

g4653.definition: σκοτία , -ας, ἡ [in LXX: Job.28:3 (אֹפֶל), Mic.3:6 (חָשַׁךְ), Isa.16:3 * ;] in late writers = σκότος, darkness : Jhn.6:17 20:1 . Metaphorical, __(a) of secrecy (opposite to ἐν τ. φωτί): Mat.10:27 , Luk.12:3 ; __(b) of spiritual darkness : Mat.4:16 , Jhn.1:5 8:12 12:35, 40 , 1Jn.1:5 Jn 2:8-9 Jn 2:11 .† (AS)

g4654.definition: σκοτίζω (σκότος), [in LXX for חָשַׁךְ ;] to darken ; in NT always pass., -ομαι, to be darkened : of the heavenly bodies, Mat.24:29 , Mrk.13:24 , Luk.23:45 (Rec., WH, mg.), Rev.8:12. Metaphorical, of the mind, Rom.1:21 11:10 " (LXX) (cf. σκοτόω).† (AS)

g4655.definition: σκότος , -ου, ὁ the more usual cl. form (cf.σ., τό), darkness : Heb.12:18 , Rec.† (AS)

g4656.definition: σκοτόω , -ῶ (σκότος), [in LXX for חָשַׁךְ, קָדַר, שָׁחַר ;] to darken : Rev.9:2 16:10 . Metaphorical, of the mind! pass., Eph.4:18 (cf. σκοτίζω).† (AS)

g4657.definition: σκύβαλον , -ου, τό [in LXX: Sir.27:4 * ;] refuse, esp. dung (see MM, ii, iii, xxiii): Php.3:8. † (AS)

g4658.definition: Σκύθης , -ου, ὁ Scythian, an inhabitant of Scythia, i.e. Russia and Siberia, a synonym with the Greeks for the wildest of barbarians: Col.3:11. † (AS)

g4659.definition: σκυθρωπός , -όν (also -ή, -όν) (σκυθρός, sullen, + ὤψ), [in LXX: Gen.40:7 (רַע), etc. ;] of a gloomy countenance : Mat.6:16 , Luk.24:17 .† (AS)

g4660.definition: σκύλλω __1. in cl., to skin, flay, rend (Æsch., Anthol.). __2. In Hellenistic writers, to vex, trouble, annoy : with accusative of person(s), Mrk.5:35 , Luk.8:49 ; pass., ἐσκυλμένοι, distressed, Mat.9:36; mid., to trouble oneself, μὴ σκύλλου, Luk.7:6 (frequently in π.; see MM, i, ii, and cf. M, Pr. , 89; Abbott…

g4662.definition: σκωληκό-βρωτος , -ον (σκώληξ, βιβρώσκω), eaten of worms : Act.12:23 (cf. 2Ma.9:9 , and see MM, xxiii) † (AS)

g4664.definition: σμαράγδινος (σμάραγδος, which see), __1. of emerald (Luc., V.H., ii, 11). __2. As in π. (Deiss., BS, 267), emerald-green : Rev.4:3 (for the construction, see Swete, in l; Zorell, see word).† (AS)

g4665.definition: σμάραγδος , -ου, ἡ (and in late writers also ὁ), [in LXX: Exo.28:9 (שֹׁהַם) Exo.36:17 ( Exo.39:10 ) (בָּרֶקֶת), Eze.28:13 (יַהֲלֹם), etc. ;] emerald or other trans parent green stone (LS, see word; DB , iv, 620; Swete, Ap., 67, 288): Rev.21:19. † (AS)

g4669.definition: σμυρνίζω (σιύρνα), __1. intrans., to be like myrrh (Diosc., i, 79). __2. Trans., to mingle or drug with myrrh : pass., Mrk.15:23. † (AS)

g4672.definition: Σολομών , -ῶνος (so prop., but Rec. has frequently -ῶν, -ῶντος, as also WH in Act.3:11 5:12 ; in Act.7:47 T has Σαλωμών, as LXX freq., indecl.; see B1., § 10, 1; Tdf., Prol., 104, 119; WH, App. , 158), ὁ (Heb. שְׁלֹמֹה), Solomon : Mat.1:6-7 6:29 12:42 , Luk.11:31 12:27 , Jhn.10:23 , Act.3:11 5:12 7:47 .† (AS)

g4676.definition: σουδάριον , -ου, τό(Lat.), handkerchief, kerchief : Luk.19:20 , Act.19:12 ; used as a head covering for the dead, Jhn.11:44 20:7 (cf. Deiss., BS, 223).† (AS)

g4677.definition: Σουσάννα , -ης (cf. Dan LXX TH Su, inscr., 2, 7, al.) Susanna : Luk.8:3. † (AS)

g4678.definition: σοφία , -ας, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for חׇכְמָה ;] skill, intelligence, wisdom , ranging from knowledge of the arts and matters of daily life to mental excellence in its highest and fullest sense; __(a) of human wisdom : 1Co.2:1 2:4-5 , Jas.3:15 , Rev.13:18 17:9 ; σ. Σολομῶνος, Mat.12:42 , Luk.11:31 ; Αἰγυπτίων, Act.7:22…

g4680.definition: σοφός , -ή, -όν [in LXX chiefly for חָכָם ;] skilled, clever, wise, whether in handicraft, the affairs of life, the sciences or learning : Rom.16:19 , 1Co.3:10 ; of the learned, Rom.1:14, 22 , 1Co.1:19-20 1:26-27 3:18-20 ; of Jewish teachers, Mat.11:25 , Luk.10:21 ; Christian, Mat.23:34; of those en­dowed with…

g4681.definition: Σπανία , -ας, ἡ (= cl. Ἑσπερία or Ἰβηρία; late writers adopted the Roman name, Ἱσπανία ( 1Ma.8:3 ) or Σ. as here), Spain : Rom.15:24, 28 .† (AS)

g4682.definition: σπαράσσω [in LXX: 2Ki.22:8 B (גָּעַשׁ hith.), Jhn.4:19 (הָמָה) Dan LXX 8:7 (שָׁלַךְ hi.), 3Ma.4:6 * ;] __1. to tear, rend, mangle. __2. to convulse : Mrk.1:26 (see Swete, in l) Mrk.9:26 , Luk.9:39 (cf. συν-σπαράσσω).† (AS)

g4683.definition: σπαργανόω , -ῶ (σπάργανον, a swathing-band) [in LXX: Job.38:9 , Eze.16:4 (חָתַל pu.)* ;] to swathe, wrap in swaddling-clothes : Luk.2:7, 12 (Hipp., Arist., Plut.).† (AS)

g4687.definition: σπείρω [in LXX chiefly for זָרַע ;] to sow (seed): absol., Mat.6:26 13:3-4, 18 25:24, 26 , Mrk.4:3-4 , Luk.8:5 12:24 , Jhn.4:36 , 2Co.9:10 ; with accusative of thing(s), Mat.13:24, 27 13:37, 39 , Mrk.4:32 , Luk.8:5 , 1Co.15:36-37 ; before εἰς, Mat.13:22 , Mrk.4:18 ; ἐν, Mat.13:24, 31 ; ἐπί, with genitive, Mrk.4:31…

g4688.definition: σπεκουλάτωρ, -ορος (Rec. -ωρος), ὁ (Lat. speculator), __1. prop., a spy or scout. __2. An executioner : Mrk.6:27 (see Swete, in l).† (AS)

g4689.definition: σπένδω [in LXX chiefly for נָסַךְ hi. ;] to pour out as a drink-offering, make a libation ; pass., figuratively, σπένδομαι, I am poured out or offered as a libation (in the shedding of my life-blood): Php.2:17 (see Lft., in l), 2Ti.4:6 (for exx. from π., see Milligan, Selections, 114 f.; MM, xxiii).† (AS)

g4690.definition: σπέρμα , -τος, τό (σπείρω) [in LXX chiefly for זֶרַע ;] seed ; __(a) of plants : Mat.13:24, 27 13:37-38 , 2Co.9:10 ; pl., Mat.13:32 , Mrk.4:31 , 1Co.15:33 ; metaphorically, of an escaping remnant (שָׂרִיד, Isa.1:9; cf. Wis.14:6; Plat., Tim., 23c; FlJ, Ant. , xi, 5, 3), Rom.9:29; __(b) of men (as γονή; Lat. semen…

g4692.definition: σπεύδω [in LXX chiefly for מָהַר pi., also for בָּהַל pi., hi., etc. ;] __1. most frequently intrans., to hasten : with inf. (as frequently in cl.), Act.20:16; ptcp. with indic., Luk.2:16; with imperat., Luk.19:5-6; σπεῦσον κ. ἔξελθε, Act.22:18 __2. Trans., with accusative; __(a) to hasten, urge on, accelerate (as…

g4693.definition: σπήλαιον , -ου, τό [in LXX chiefly for מְעָרָה ;] a cave, cavern : Jhn.11:38 , Heb.11:38 , Heb.6:15 ; σ. (EV, den) λῃστῶν ( Jhn.7:11 ), Mat.21:13 , Mrk.11:17 , Luk.19:46 .† (AS)

g4695.definition: σπιλόω [in LXX: Wis.15:4 * ;] to stain, spot, defile : with accusative, Jas.3:6 , Ju 23 .† (AS)

g4696.definition: σπίλος (Rec. σπῖλος), -ου, ὁ __1. a rock, cliff (Arist., al.). __2. In late writers = Att.. κηλίς (see Rutherford, NPhr. , 87 f.), a spot, stain; metaphorically, __(a) of moral blemish : Eph.5:27 __(b) of riotous and lascivious persons (cf. Dion. Hal., quoted by Mayor, in l): 2Pe.2:13. † (AS)

g4697.definition: σπλαγχνίζομαι (σπλάγχνον), [in LXX (act., -ίζω): Pro.17:5 A, 2Ma.6:8 (= -εύω) * ;] to be moved as to the σπλάγχνα (which see), hence, to feel pity or compassion : absol., Luk.10:33 15:20 ; ptcp., σπλαγχνισθείς, with indic., Mat.18:27 20:34 , Mrk.1:41 ; before ἐπί, with dative of person(s), Mat.14:14 , Luk.7:13 ; ἐπί…

Metaphorical, of…

g4699.definition: σπόγγος , -ου, ὁ a sponge : Mat.27:48 , Mrk.15:36 , Jhn.19:29 .† (AS)

g4700.definition: σποδός , -oῦ, ὁ [in LXX chiefly for אֵפֶר ;] ashes : Heb.9:13; ἐν σάκκῳ καὶ σ. ( Isa.58:5 , Jhn.3:6 , Dan LXX 9:3, al.), Mat.11:21 , Luk.10:13 .† (AS)

g4701.definition: σπορά , -ᾶς, ἡ (σπείρω), [in LXX: 4Ki.19:29 (זָרַע), 1Ma.10:30 * ;] __1. a sowing. __2. seedtime. __3. seed sown (of human offspring, Soph., Tr., 316, 420): 1Pe.1:23 (cf. σπέρμα, and see Milligan, NTD , 105 f.).† (AS)

g4702.definition: σπόριμος , -ον (σπείρω) [in LXX: Gen.1:29 , Lev.11:37 (זָרַע), Sir 40:22 א1 * ;] fit for sowing, sown ; as subst., τὰ σ., corn-fields : Mat.12:1 , Mrk.2:23 , Luk.6:1 .† (AS)

g4703.definition: σπόρος , -ου, ὁ (σπείρω), [in LXX chiefly for זֶרַע ;] = σπορά, __1. sowing or seedtime. __2. seed sown (so usually in late Gk.): Mrk.4:26-27 , Luk.8:5, 11 , 2Co.9:10 a (LTr.); metaphorically, of almsgiving, 2Co.9:10 b.† (AS)

g4704.definition: σπουδάζω (σπουδή), [in LXX chiefly for בָּהַל ;] to make haste; hence, to be zealous or eager, to give diligence : with inf. (see M, Pr. , 205 f.), Gal.2:10 , Eph.4:3 , 1Th.2:17 , 2Ti.2:15 4:9 4:21 , Tit.3:12 , Heb.4:11 , 2Pe.1:10 3:14 ; with accusative and inf. (on this construction see Mayor in l; MM, xxiii)…

g4786.definition: συν-κεράννυμι (Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: Dan LXX 2:43 (עֲרַב ithpa.), 2Ma.15:39 * ;] to mix or blend together, compound : with accusative, 1Co.12:24; ptcp. pf. pass., Heb.4:2 , T, WH, mg., R, mg.; id., of persons, with dative instr., to be united with, agree with, ib., WH, txt., R, txt. (see Westc., in l).† (AS)

g4787.definition: συν-κινέω (Rec. συγκ-), -ῶ, to move together. Metaphorical, to excite, stir up : τ. λαόν, Act.6:12 (Arist., Polyb., al.).† (AS)

g4788.definition: συν-κλείω (Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX chiefly for סגר ;] to shut together, enclose, shut in on all sides : of a catch of fish, Luk.5:6; metaphorically ( Psa.31:9 , al.), Rom.11:32 , Gal.3:22-23 .† (AS)

g4789.definition: συν-κληρο-νόμος (Rec. συγκ-), -ου, ὁ a co-inheritor, fellow-heir : Rom.8:17 , Eph.3:6 ; with genitive of thing(s), Heb.11:9 , 1Pe.3:7 (for exx., see Deiss., LAE , 88 f.).† (AS)

g4790.definition: συν-κοινωνέω (Rec. συγκ-), -ῶ, to have fellowship with or in (in cl., with genitive of thing(s), dative of person(s)): with dative of thing(s), Eph.5:11 , Rev.18:4 ; id. with genitive of person(s), Php.4:14. † (AS)

g4791.definition: συν-κοινωνός (Rec. συγκ-), όν, partaking jointly of : with genitive of thing(s), Rom.11:17 , 1Co.9:23 ; id. with genitive of person(s), Php.1:7; before ἐν, Rev.1:9. † (AS)

g4793.definition: συν-κρίνω (Rec. συγκ-) [in LXX chiefly for פָּתַר ;] __1. to compound, combine : 1Co.2:13 , R, mg.1 (Lft., Notes , 180 f.). __2. In Arist. and later writers ( Wis.7:29 , a1.) = παραβάλλω, to compare : 1Co, l.with, R, txt. (Field, Notes , 168), 2Co.10:12 __3. In LXX, of dreams, to interpret ( Gen.40:8 , 1Co, l.with, R…

g4794.definition: συν-κύπτω (Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: Job.9:27 (עָזַב), Sir.12:11 19:26 * ;] __1. to bend forwards (Arist., al.). __2. to be bowed down : Luk.13:11. † (AS)

g4795.definition: συγκυρία , -ας, ἡ (συγκυρέω, to happen), [in Sm.: 1Ki.6:9 (מִקְרֶה) * ;] (more frequently in late writers, συγκύρησις, -ημα), chance, coincidence : κατὰ σ. (see MM, xxiii), Luk.10:31 (Hippocr., Eccl.).† (AS)

g4796.definition: συν-χαίρω (Rec. συγ-), [in LXX: Gen.21:6 (צָחַק), 3Ma.1:8 R * ;] __1. to rejoice with : with dative of person(s), Luk.1:58 15:6, 9 , Php.2:17-18 , EV; with dative of thing(s), 1Co.12:26 13:6 . __2. to congratulate (Æschin., Polyb., al.): Phi, l.with (Lft., in I.; cf. MM, xxiv).† (AS)

g4797.definition: συν-χέω (Rec. συγ-), [in LXX for בָּלַל, רָגַז, etc. ;] to pour together, commingle, confuse ; metaphorically, confound, throw into confusion, stir up trouble : Act.21:27 (cf. συν-χύννω).† (AS)

g4798.definition: συν-χράομαι (Rec. συγ-), -ῶμαι, [in Al.: 1Ki.30:19 * ;] to use together with. Metaphorical, with dative of person(s), to associate with : Jhn.4:9 (Polyb., a1.).† (AS)

g4799.definition: σύγχυσις , -εως, ἡ (συγχέω), [in LXX: Gen.11:9 (בָּבֶל), 1Ki.5:6 5:12 (11) 1Ki.14:20 (מְהוּמָה) * ;] confusion : of a popular uproar, Act.19:29. † (AS)

g4800.definition: συν-ζάω (Rec. συζ-), to live with : opposite to συναποθανεῖν, 2Co.7:3; of life in union with Christ, here and hereafter, Rom.6:8 , 2Ti.2:11 .† (AS)

g4801.definition: συν-ζεύγνυμι (Rec. συζ-), [in LXX: Eze.1:11, 23 (חָבַר) * ;] to yoke to­gether : metaphorically, of union in wedlock, Mat.19:6 , Mrk.10:9 .† (AS)

g4802.definition: συν-ζητέω (Rec. συζ-), -ῶ, [in LXX: Neh.2:4 AB1 (בָּקַשׁ pi.) * ;] __1. to search or examine together (Plat.). __2. In NT (and π., see MM, xxiii; also in M Gr. , see Kennedy, Sources , 155), to discuss, dispute : Mrk.1:27 12:28 , Luk.24:15 ; before quæst. indir., Mrk.9:10; with dative of person(s), Mrk.8:11 Act.6:9…

g4804.definition: συν-ζητητής (Rec. συζ-), -οῦ, ἁ (συνζητέω), a disputer, disputant : 1Co.1:20. † (AS)

g4806.definition: συν-ζωο-ποιέω (Rec. συζ-), ῶ-, to make alive or quicken together with ; metaphorically, of the spiritual life: τ. Χριστῷ, Eph.2:5; σὺν τ. Χ., Col.2:13. † (AS)

g4807.definition: συκάμινος , -ου, ἡ [in LXX for שִׁקְמָה (pl.) ;] the mulberry tree (Lat. morus; cf. μόρον, 1Ma.6:34 *), the sycamine : Luk.17:6. (In LXX, σ. appears to represent the συκόμορος (see: συκομορέα), but St. Luke distinguishes between the two; see ICC , in l; DB , iv, 634.) † (AS)

g4808.definition: συκῆ (contr. fr. συκέα), -ῆς, ἡ (σῦκον), [in LXX for תְּאֵן ;] a fig-tree : Mat.21:19-21 24:32 , Mrk.11:13, 20-21 13:28 , Luk.13:6-7 21:29 , Jhn.1:49, 51 , Jas.3:12 , Rev.6:13 .† (AS)

g4809.definition: συκο-μορέα (Rec. -μωραία, L, -μωρέα), -ας, ἡ, more commonly (so Aq., Sm., Psa.78:47 , Isa.9:10 ) συκόμορος (σῦκον + μόρον, the black mulberry), a fig-mulberry, a sycamore : Luk.19:4 (cf. συκάμινος).† (AS)

g4810.definition: σῦκον , -ου, τό [in LXX for תְּאֵן ] a fig : Mat.7:16 , Mrk.11:13 , Luk.6:44 Jas.3:12 .† (AS)

g4811.definition: συκοφαντέω , -ῶ (σῦκον, φαίνω), [in LXX: Gen.43:18 (גָּלַל hithpo.), Lev.19:11 (שָׁקַר pi.), Job.35:9 , Psa.119:122 , Pro.14:31 2:16 28:3 , Ecc.4:1 (עָשַׁק) ;] to act the συκοφάντης (on conjectures as to the origin of the term, see LS, see word), to accuse falsely (Aristoph., Xen., al.): Luk.3:14 (R, mg.) Luk.19:8…

g4813.definition: συλάω , -ῶ [in LXX: Ep. Jer.1:18 * ;] with accusative of person(s), to strip, plunder, spoil : 2Co.11:8. † (AS)

g4814.definition: to talk or converse with another, (New Testament) (ML)

C.…

g4816.definition: συλ-λέγω [in LXX chiefly for לָקַט ;] to bring together, collect, gather up : with accusative of thing(s), Mat.13:28-30; pass., Mat.13:40; with accusative, before ἀπό, Mat.7:16; id. before ἐκ, Mat.13:41 , Luk.6:44 ; before εἰς, Mat.13:48. † (AS)

g4817.definition: συλ-λογίζομαι [in LXX chiefly for חָשַׁב pi. ;] __1. to compute. __2. to reason : Luk.20:5. † (AS)

g4818.definition: συν-λυπέω (Rec. συλλ-), -ῶ, [in LXX: Psa.69:20 , Isa.51:19 (נוּד) * ;] to make to grieve with (Arist.). Pass., to be moved to grief by sympathy : before ἐπί, with dative, Mrk.3:5. † (AS)

g4819.definition: συμ-βαίνω [in LXX for עָשָׂה, קָרָא, קָרָה, etc. ;] __1. to stand with the feet together. __2. to come together, come to terms. __3. Of events, to come to pass, happen : with dative of person(s), Mrk.10:32 , Act.3:10 20:19 , 1Co.10:11 , 1Pe.4:12 , 2Pe.2:22 ; absol., τὰ σνμβεβηκότα, Luk.24:14 (cf. 1Ma.4:26 ); with…

g4820.definition: συν-βάλλω (Rec. συμ-), [in LXX: 2Ch.25:19 (גָּרָה hith.), Isa.46:6 (זוּל), Jer.43:3 (סוּת hi.), Wis.5:8 , al. ;] to throw together, hence, __(a) of speech (before λόγους, Eur., al.), to discuss, confer (sc. λόγους): with dative of person(s), Luk.11:53 , WH, mg., Act.17:18; before πρὸς ἀλλήλους, Act.4:15; __(b) to…

g4821.definition: συμ-βουλεύω [in LXX chiefly for יָעַץ ;] __1. to advise, counsel : with dative of person(s), Jhn.18:14; id. before inf., Rev.3:18. __2. Mid., to take counsel, consult : before ἵνα, Mat.26:4 ("reciprocal middle," see M, Pr. , 157); with inf., Act.9:23. † (AS)

g4822.definition: συν-βιβάζω (Rec. συμ-), [in LXX: Exo.4:12, 15 , Lev.10:11 , Jdg.13:8 , Psa.32:8 (יָרָה hi.); Exo.18:16 , Deu.4:9 , Isa.40:13 (יָדַע hi.), Isa.40:14 (בִּין hi.), Da TH Dan.9:22 (שָׂכַל hi.) * ;] __1. to join or knit together, unite : Eph.4:16 , Col.2:2 (but see infr.), Col.2:19. __2. to compare, consider, conclude…

By meton., a…

g4825.definition: σύμβουλος , -ου, ὁ (σύν, βουλή), [in LXX for יָעַץ and cogn. forms ;] a counsellor, adviser : Rom.11:34 (LXX).† (AS)

g4826.definition: Συμεών , ὁ indecl., (Heb. שִׁמְעוֹן), Simeon (so always AV; RV in Luk.2:25, 34 only), Symeon, a Heb. name for which the Gk. Σίμων, which see, was also used; __1. the son of Jacob ( Gen.29:33 ): Rev.7:7 . __2. An ancestor of our Lord : Luk.3:30 __3. An aged worshipper in the Temple : Luk.2:25, 34 . __4. One surnamed…

g4827.definition: συν-μαθητής (Rec. συμμ-), -οῦ, ὁ a fellow-disciple : Jhn.11:16 (on the use of συν- in such compounds as this, see Rutherford, NPhr. , 255 f.).† (AS)

g4828.definition: συν-μαρτυρέω (Rec. συμμ-), -ῶ, to bear witness with : Rom.2:15; with dative, Rom.8:16; before ὅτι, Rom.9:1. † (AS)

g4829.definition: συν-μερίζω (Rec. συμμ-), [in LXX: Pro.29:24 א2 (חָלַק) * ;] to distri­bute in shares. Mid., to have a share in : 1Co.9:13 (Diod., al.).† (AS)

g4830.definition: συν-μέτοχος (Rec. συμμ-), -ον, partaking together with ; as subst., ὁ σ., a joint partaker (with dative of person(s) and genitive of thing(s), FlJ, BJ, i, 24, 6): with genitive of thing(s), Eph.3:6; with genitive of person(s), Eph.5:7 (Arist.).† (AS)

g4832.definition: σύμ-μορφος , -ον (σύν, μορφή), __1. absol., similar (Luc.). __2. con­formed to : with dative, Php.3:21; with genitive, Rom.8:29 (see B1., § 36, 11; 37, 6).† (AS)

g4834.definition: συν-παθέω (Rec. συμπ-), -ῶ, [in LXX: 4Ma.5:25 AR 4Ma.13:23 * ;] to have a fellow feeling for or with, sympathize with or in : with dative of thing(s), Heb.4:15; dative of person(s), Heb.10:34 (Arist., Plut., al.).† (AS)

g4836.definition: συν-παρα-γίνομαι (Rec. συμπ-), [in LXX: Psa.83:8 (לָוָה ni.) * ;] __1. to come up or be present together : before ἐπί, Luk.23:48. __2. to come up to assist (Thuc., al.; 2Ti.4:16 , Rec.).† (AS)

g4837.definition: συν-παρα-καλέω (Rec. συμπ-), -ῶ, to call upon or exhort together (Plat.). Pass., to be strengthened or comforted with and among : Rom.1:12. † (AS)

g4838.definition: συν-παρα-λαμβάνω (Rec. συμπ-), [in LXX: Gen.19:17 (סָפָה ni.), Job.1:4 (שָׁלַח ni), 3Ma.1:1 * ;] to take along with : as a companion, with accusative, Act.12:25 15:37-38 (on the tenses, see M, Pr. , 130), Gal.2:1. † (AS)

g4840.definition: συν-πάρειμι (Rec. σνμπ-), [in LXX: Tob.12:12 ΑΒ, Pro.8:27 (?), Wis.9:10 * ;] to be present together or with : with dative of person(s), Act.25:24. † (AS)

g4841.definition: συν-πάσχω (Rec. συμπ-), [in Al.: 1Ki.22:8 * ;] __1. to suffer together or with : Rom.8:17 , 1Co.12:28 . __2. to sympathize with (Plat., Arist.).† (AS)

g4842.definition: συν-πέμπω (Rec. συμπ-) to send together with : with accusative and dative, 2Co.8:22; id. before μετά, with genitive, 2Co.8:18. † (AS)

g4843.definition: συν-περι-λαμβάνω (Rec. συμπ-), __1. to enclose ( Eze.5:3 (צוּר) *). __2. to embrace : with accusative of person(s), Act.20:10. † (AS)

By meton., of the party itself, the guests (Plut); pl., σ. σ. (colloq.; see M, Pr. , 97), in parties…

g4846.definition: συν-πνίγω (Rec. συμπ-), to choke : of thronging by a crowd, Luk.8:42. Fig., of seed, τ. λόγον, Mat.13:22 , Mrk.4:7, 19 , Luk.8:14 .† (AS)

g4847.definition: συν-πολίτης (Rec. σνμπ-), -ου, ὁ a fellow-citizen : pl., σ. τ. ἁγίων, opposite to ξένοι κ. πάροικοι, Eph.2:19 (Eur.; C.I., 6446; condemned by Atticists; see Rutherford, NPhr. , 255 f.).† (AS)

g4848.definition: συν-πορεύομαι (Rec. σνμπ-), [in LXX chiefly for הָלַךְ ;] __1. to journey together (Plat., al.): with dative of person(s), Luk.7:11 14:25 24:15 . __2. to come together : Mrk.10:1 (Plut., al.).† (AS)

g4851.definition: συμ-φέρω [in LXX: Jer.33:14 (טוֹב), Pro.19:10 (נָאוֶה), Sir.30:19 , al. ;] __1. trans. to bring together: with accusative of thing(s), Act.19:19. __2. Intrans., and mostly impers., συμφέρει, it is expedient, profitable or an advantage : 1Co.6:12 10:23 , 2Co.8:10 ; with inf. (M, Pr. , 210), Mat.19:10 , Jhn.18:14 ; with…

g4852.definition: σύν φημι (Rec. συμ-), to consent, confess : with dative, before ὅτι, Rom.7:16. † (AS)

g4853.definition: συμ-φυλέτης , -ου, ὁ (σύν, φυλή; cf. σύμφυλος, Aq.: Zec.13:7; and see Rutherford, NPhr. , 255 f.) a fellow-tribesman, fellow-countryman : 1Th.2:14 (see M, Th. , in l, and Intr. liii). Not found elsewhere.† (AS)

g4854.definition: σύμ-φυτος , -ον (συμφύω, to make to grow together) [in LXX: Zec.11:2 (בָּצַר), Est.7:7 Est.7:8 א2, Amo.9:13 , 3Ma.3:22 * ;] __1. congenital, innate (Plat., al.; 3Mac, l.with). __2. grown along with, united with : τ. ὁμοιώματι τ. θανάτου αὐτσῦ (see Field, Notes , 155 f.), Rom.6:5. † (AS)

g4855.definition: συν-φύω (Rec. συμ-), [in LXX: Wis.13:13 * ;] to cause to grow together. Pass., to grow together or with (Plat. al.): Luk.8:7. † (AS)

g4856.definition: συμ-φωνέω , -ῶ, [in LXX: Gen.14:3 (H2266) 2Ki.12:8 (9) (H225 ni.), Isa.7:2 (H5117), 4Ma.14:6 * ;] prop., to agree in sound, be in harmony (Plat., Arist.). Metaphorical, __(a) to agree with, agree together : Luk.5:36; with dative of thing(s), Act.15:15; before περί, Mat.18:19; pass., with dative of person(s)…

g4858.definition: συμφωνία , -ας, ἡ (σύμφωνος), [in LXX: Dan LXX TH Dan.3:5, 15 , TH Dan.3:7, 10 (סוּמְפּוֹנְיָה) 4Ma.14:3 A * ;] __1. symphony, music : Luk.15:25 __2. a musical instrument (Polyb., al.; Da, ll. with; v MM, xxiv).† (AS)

g4859.definition: σύμφωνος , -ον (ούν, φωνή), [in LXX: Ecc.7:14 (עֻמָּה), 4Ma.7:7 4Mac 14:7 * ;] agreeing in sound. Metaphorical, harmonious, agreeing : ἐκ συμφώνου (for exx. from π., see Deiss., BS, 255), by agreement, 1Co.7:5. † (AS)

g4860.definition: συμ-ψηφίζω [in LXX: Jer.29:20 ( Jer.49:20 ) A * ;] to reckon together, count up : Act.19:19. † (AS)

g4863.definition: συν-άγω [in LXX chiefly for אָסַף, also for קָבַץ, etc. (cf. Kennedy, Sources , 128) ;] to gather or bring together : of things, Jhn.6:12-13; before εἰς, Mat.3:12 , al.; ἐκεῖ, Luk.12:18; ποῦ, Luk.12:17; συναγαγὼν πάντα (sc. εἰς ἀργύριον; see Field, Notes , 68, MM, xxiv), having sold off all : Luk.15:13; of persons…

g4865.definition: συν-αγωνίζομαι to strive together with, to help (prop., of sharing in a contest): with dative of person(s) and of thing(s), Rom.15:30. † (AS)

g4866.definition: συν-αθλέω , -ῶ = συναγωνίζομαι : with dative commod., Php.1:27; with dative of person(s), before ἐν, Php.4:3. † (AS)

g4867.definition: συν-αθροίζω [in LXX chiefly for קָבַץ ;] to gather together, assemble : with accusative of person(s), Act.19:25; pass., Act.12:12. † ἀθροίζω (ἀθρόος, assembled in crowds, MM, VGT , see word; θρόος, a noise, tumult), [in LXX chiefly for קָבַץ ;] to Gather, assemble : Luk.24:33. † (AS)

g4868.definition: συν-αίρω [in LXX: Exo.23:5 (עָזַב) * ;] to take up together : σ. λόγον (of which there are several exx. in π.; see Deiss., LAE , 118 f.; MM, i, xxiv; M, Pr. , 160), to settle accounts, Mat.18:23-24; before μετά, C. genitive of person(s), Mat.25:19. † (AS)

g4869.definition: συν-αιχμάλωτος , -ου, ὁ a fellow prisoner (prop., of a captive in war, see Lft., Col., 234): Rom.16:7 , Col.4:10 , Phm 23.† (AS)

g4870.definition: συν-ακολουθέω , -ῶ [in LXX: 2Ma.2:4 2Mac 2:6 * ;] to follow along with, accompany : with dative of person(s), Mrk.14:51 , Luk.23:49 ; before μετά, with genitive of person(s), Mrk.5:37. † (AS)

g4872.definition: συν-ανα-βαίνω [in LXX for עָלָה ;] to go up with : with dative of person(s), before εἰς, with accusative loc., Mrk.15:41 , Act.13:31 .† (AS)

g4873.definition: συν-ανά-κειμαι [in LXX: 3Ma.5:39 * ;] to recline with or together at table : Mat.14:9 , Mrk.6:22 , Luk.7:49 14:15 ; with dative of person(s), Mat.9:10 , Mrk.2:15 , Luk.14:10 .† (AS)

g4973.definition: σφραγίς , -ῖδος, ἡ [in LXX: Exo.28:11 , al. (חוֹתָם) Exo.35:22 (חָח), Sir.17:22 , al. ;] __1. a seal, signet : Rev.7:2. __2. The impression of a seal or signet, a seal (on its various purposes, see: σφραγίζω): on a book or roll, Rev.5:1-2, 5 5:9 6:1, 3 6:5, 7 6:9, 12 8:1 ; metaphorically, Rom.4:11 , 1Co.9:2 , 2Ti.2:19…

g4974.definition: σφυρόν , -οῦ, τό, [in LXX: Job.41:21 (לָהַט) * ;] the ankle : Act.3:7 , Rec. (T, WH, σφυδρόν; see Bl., § 6, 8).† (AS)

g4975.definition: σχέδον adv. (ἔχω), [in LXX: 2Ma.5:2 , 3Ma.5:14 3Mac 5:45 * ;] __1. of place, near. __2. Of degree, almost, nearly : Act.13:44 19:26 , Heb.9:22 .† (AS)

g4976.definition: σχῆμα , -τος, τό (ἔχω), [in LXX: Isa.3:17 (פֹּת) * ;] figure, fashion : 1Co.7:31 , Php.2:8 .† SYN. : see: μορφή (AS)

g4977.definition: σχίζω [in LXX chiefly for בָּקַע ;] to cleave, rend : Mat.27:51 , Mrk.1:10 15:38 , Luk.5:36 23:45 , Jhn.19:24 21:11 ; metaphorically, in pass., to be divided into factions, Act.14:4 23:7 .† (AS)

g4978.definition: σχίσμα , -τος, τό (σχίζω), a rent (Arist., al.): Mat.9:16 , Mrk.2:21 . Metaphorical, a dissension, division : Jhn.7:43 9:16 10:19 , 1Co.1:10 11:18 12:25 .† SYN. : see: αἵρεσις (AS)

g4979.definition: σχοινίον , -ου, τό (dimin. of σχοῖνος, a rush), [in LXX chiefly for a rope (prop., one made of rushes): Jhn.2:15 , Act.27:32 .† (AS)

g4980.definition: σχολάζω (σχολή), [in LXX: Exo.5:8, 17 , Psa.46:10 (רָפָה ni., hi.) * ;] to be at leisure, hence, to have time or opportunity for, to devote oneself to, be occupied in : 1Co.7:5; of things, to be unoccupied, empty (Plut., Eur., al.): οἶκος, Mat.12:44 , Luk.11:25 (T [WH], R, om.).† (AS)

g4981.definition: σχολή , -ῆς, ἡ [in LXX: Gen.33:14 (κατὰ σ., אַט), Pro.28:19 , Sir.38:24 * ;] __1. leisure. __2. Later (from Plato on), __(a) that for which leisure is employed, a disputation, lecture ; __(b) the place where lectures are delivered, a school : Act.19:9 (for the later sense of employment, see MM, xxiv).† (AS)

g4982.definition: σώζω (on the more accurate σῴζω, see WH, Intr. , §410; Bl., §3, 1-3), [in LXX chiefly for ישׁע hi., also for מלט ni., נצל ni., etc. ;] to save from peril, injury or suffering : Mat.8:25 , Mrk.13:20 , Luk.23:35 , al.; τ. ψυχήν, Mat.16:25 , al.; before ἐκ, Jhn.12:27 , Heb.5:7 , Ju 5 ; of healing, restoring to health…

g4983.definition: σῶμα , -τος, τό, [in LXX for גְּוִיָּה ,בָּשָׂר, etc., and for Aram. נְבֵלָה ;] a body . __1. Prop., of the human body, __(a) as always in Hom. (opposite to δέμας), of the dead body: Mat.27:58, 59 Mrk.15:43 , al.; __(b) of the living body : Luk.11:34 , 1Co.6:13 , al.; ἐν σ. εἶναι, Heb.13:3; as the instrument of the…

g4984.definition: σωματικός , -ή, -όν (σῶμα), [in LXX: 4Ma.1:32 4Mac 3:1 * ;] __(a) of or for the body, bodily : γυμνασία, 1Ti.4:8; __(b) (opposite to ἀσώματος) bodily, corporeal : εἶδος, Luk.3:22. † (AS)

g4985.definition: σωματικῶς adv. , bodily, corporeally : Col.2:9 (see ICC , Lft., in l).† (AS)

g4987.definition: σωρεύω [in LXX: Pro.25:22 (חָתָה), Jdth.15:11 * ;] __(a) to heap on : with accusative before ἐπί with accusative, Rom.12:20 (LXX) (Arist., al.); __(b) to heap with : with accusative and dative, metaphorically, ἁμαρτίαις, 2Ti.3:6 (overwhelmed with, Field, Notes , 217) (Polyb.).† (AS)

g4988.definition: Σωσθένης , -ου, ὁ Sosthenes ; __(a) a Jewish ruler : Act.18:7; __(b) a Christian : 1Co.1:1. † (AS)

g4990.definition: σωτήρ , -ῆρος, ὁ (σώζω), [in LXX for יָשַׁע and cognate forms ;] saviour, deliverer, preserver, a frequently epithet of kings in the Ptolemaic and Rom. periods (Deiss., BS, 83; LAE , 368 f.; MM, xxiv), in NT, __(a) of God (as LXX: Psa.24:5 , Isa.12:2 , al.): Luk.1:47 , 1Ti.1:1 2:3 4:10 , Tit.1:3 2:10 3:4 , Ju 25…

g4991.definition: σωτηρία , -ας, ἡ (σωτήρ), [in LXX for יֶשַׁע, יְשׁוּעָה, תְּשׁוּעָה, פְּלֵיטָה, etc. ;] deliverance, preservation, salvation, safety (Lat. salus): Act.7:25 27:34 , Heb.11:7 ; ἐξ ἐχθρῶν, Luk.1:71. In NT esp. of Messianic and spiritual salvation (see: σώζω): Luk.19:9 , Jhn.4:22 , Act.4:12 13:47 , Rom.11:11 , 2Th.2:13…

g4993.definition: σωφρονέω , -ῶ (σώφρων), __(a) to be of sound mind or in one's right mind : Mrk.5:15 , Luk.8:35 ; opposite to ἐκστῆναι, 2Co.5:13 (Hdt.); __(b) to be temperate, discreet, self-controlled (opposite to μαίνεσθαι, ὑβρίζειν, etc.; sch., Thuc., al.): Tit.2:6; opposite to ὑπερφρονεῖν, Rom.12:3; σ. καὶ νήφειν, 1Pe.4:7. † (AS)

g4995.definition: σωφρονισμός , -οῦ, ὁ (σωφρονίζω), __(a) an admonishing (F1J, Plut., al.); __(b) self-control, self-discipline : 2Ti.1:7 (on the reflexive meaning here, see Ellic., in l).† (AS)

g4996.definition: σωφρόνως adv. , [in LXX: Wis.9:11 * ;] with sound mind, prudently, soberly : Tit.2:12. † (AS)

g4997.definition: σωφροσύνη , -ης, ἡ [in LXX: Est.3:13 , Wis.8:7 , 2Ma.4:37 , 4Ma.6:1-35 * ;] __(a) soundness of mind, good sense, sanity (opposite to μανία, Xen.): Act.26:25; __(b) self-control, sobriety : 1Ti.2:9 (see Tr., Syn. , § xx), 1Ti.2:15. † (AS)

g4998.definition: σώφρων , -ον [in LXX: 4Ma.9:1-32 * ;] __(a) of sound mind, sane, sensible ; __(b) self-controlled, sober-minded : 1Ti.3:2 , Tit.1:8 2:2, 5 (Arist.).† (AS)

g5000.definition: Ταβειθά (Rec. Ταβιθά), ἡ (Aram. טַבְיְתָא or טְבִיתָא), Tabitha : Act.9:36, 40 (cf. Δορκάς).† (AS)

g5001.definition: τάγμα , -τος, τό (τάσσω), [in LXX chiefly for דֶּגֶל, also for חַי, רַגְלִי ;] that which has been arranged or placed in order ; esp. as military term, a company, troop, division, rank : metaphorically, 1Co.15:23 (see ICC , in l).† (AS)

g5004.definition: ταλαιπωρία , -ας, ἡ (ταλαίπωρος) [in LXX chiefly for שֹׁד ;] __1. hard work (Hippocr.). __2. hardship, suffering, distress : Rom.3:16 (LXX) pl., Jas.5:1 (see B1., § 32, 6; WM, 220; Swete, Mk. , 153). (Hdt., Thuc., al.; and cf. MM, xxiv.)† (AS)

g5005.definition: ταλαίωρος , -ον [in LXX: Psa.137:8 (שָׁדַד), Isa.33:1 (ποιεῖν τ., שָׁדַד), Tob.13:10 , Wis.3:11 , al. ;] distressed, miserable, wretched : Rom.7:24 , Rev.3:17 .† (AS)

g5006.definition: ταλαντιαῖος , -α, -ον (τάλαντον), __(a) worth a talent ; __(b) of a talent's weight : Rev.16:21. † (AS)

g5007.definition: τάλαντομ , -ον, τ [in LXX for כִּכָּר ;] __1. a balance (Hom.). __2. that which is weighed, a talent ; __(a) a talent in weight (in Horn. always of gold); __(b) a sum of money, whether gold or silver, equivalent to a talent in weight (see DB , iii, 418 ff.): Mat.18:24 25:15 ff.† (AS)

g5008.definition: ταλειθά (Rec. ταλιθά), (Aram. טְלִיתָא, see Dalman, Gr. , 150), talitha, i.e. maiden: Mrk.5:41. † (AS)

g5009.definition: ταμεῖον (late syncopated form of cl. ταμιεῖον; see M, Pr. , 44 f.; Bl., § 6, 5; Thackeray, Gr. , 63 ff.; Deiss., BS, 182 f.), -ον, τό, [in LXX chiefly for חֶדֶר ;] __1. a treasury (Thuc., al). __2. a store-chamber (Arist., Xen.; Deu.28:8 ): Luk.12:24 . __3. an inner chamber (Xen., Hell., v, 4, 5 Isa.26:20 , al.)…

g5010.definition: τάξις , -εως, ἡ (τάσσω), [in LXX: Job.38:12 (מָקוֹם), Psa.110:4 (דִּבְרָה), 2Ma.9:18 , al. ;] __1. an arranging, hence, in military sense, disposition of an army, battle array (Thuc., al.). __2. arrangement, order (Plat., al): Luk.1:8. __3. due order : Col.2:5 ( ICC , in l); κατὰ τάξιν, 1Co.14:40. __4. office, order…

g5011.definition: ταπεινός , -ή, -όν [in LXX for שָׁפָל, עָנִי, etc. ;] low-lying ; metaphorically, __(a) lowly, of low degree, brought low : Jas.1:9 , 2Co.7:6 (cf. Sir.25:23 ); οἱ τ., opposite to δυνάσται, Luk.1:52; τ. ταπεινοῖς (neut., R, txt.; masc., R, mg.; see ICC , in l), Rom.12:16; __(b) lowly in spirit, humble, in cl. usually…

g5012.definition: ταπεινοφροσύνη , -ης, ἡ (ταπεινόφρων) lowliness of mind, humility : Act.20:19 , Eph.4:2 , Php.2:3 , Col.3:12 , 1Pe.5:5 ; of a false humility, Col.2:18, 23 (rare outside of NT, but found in bad sense in FlJ, BJ, iv, 9, 2; also in Epictet., see Tr., Syn. , § xlii).† (AS)

g5013.definition: ταπεινόω , -ῶ (ταπεινός), [in LXX chiefly for עָנָה, also for שָׁפֵל, כָּנַע, etc. ;] to make low : ὄρος (βουνόν), Luk.3:5 (LXX). Metaphorical, to humble, abase : Mat.18:4 23:12 , Luk.14:11 18:14 , 2Co.11:7 12:21 , Php.2:8 ; pass., Mat.23:12 , Luk.14:11 18:14 , Php.4:12 ; id. with mid. sense, Jas.4:10 , 1Pe.5:6 .† (AS)

g5014.definition: ταπείνωσις , -εως, ἡ (ταπεινόω), [in LXX chiefly for עֳנִי ;] abasement, humiliation, low estate : Luk.1:48 , Act.8:33 " (LXX), Php.3:21 , Jas.1:10 (Plat., Arist., and later writers).† (AS)

g5015.definition: ταράσσω [in LXX for בָּהַל, רָגַז, etc., forty-six words in all ;] to disturb, trouble, stir up : primarily in physical sense (Hom., Eur.): τ. ὕδωρ, Jhn.1:5 [4], Jhn.1:7. Metaphorical, of the mind (Æsch., Plat., al.), to trouble, disquiet, perplex : Act.15:24 , Gal.1:7 5:10 ; ἑαυτόν (troubled himself; Westc., in l)…

g5019.definition: Ταρσός , -oῦ Tarsus, a city of Cilicia : Act.9:30 11:25 22:3 .† (AS)

g5021.definition: τάσσω [in LXX chiefly for שׂוּם, also for צָוָה pi., נָתַן, etc. ;] primarily, in military sense, then generally, to draw up in order, arrange in place, assign, appoint, order : with dative (accusative) and inf. (Bl., § 72, 5), Act.15:2 18:2 (διατ-, WH) Act.22:10; ἑαυτούς, 1Co.16:15; pass., Mat.8:9 (T [WH], R, txt.…

g5022.definition: ταῦρος , -ου, ὁ [in LXX chiefly for שׁוֹר ;] a bull : Mat.22:4 , Act.14:13 , Heb.9:13 10:4 .† (AS)

g5028.definition: τάφος , -ου, ὁ (θάντω), [in LXX chiefly for קֶבֶר ;] __1. a burial (Hom., al.). __2. a grave, tomb (Res., Hdt., al.): Mat.23:27, 29 27:61, 64 27:66 28:1 , Rom.3:13 " (LXX) .† (AS)

g5029.definition: τάχα (ταχύς), adv. , [in LXX: Wis.13:6 14:19 * ;] __(a) (chiefly poët.), quickly, presently; __(b) perhaps : Rom.5:7 , Phm 15.† (AS)

g5030.definition: ταχέως (ταχύς) adv. , [in LXX chiefly for מְהֵרָה and cognate forms ;] quickly, hastily : Luk.14:21 16:6 , Jhn.11:31 , 1Co.4:19 , Php.2:19, 24 , 2Ti.4:9 ; with suggestion of rashness, Gal.1:6 , 2Th.2:2 , 1Ti.5:22 .† (AS)

g5032.definition: τάχειον , see: ταχύ. ταχύ (neut. of ταχύς), adv. , [in LXX chiefly for מָהַר pi. ;] quickly, speedily, forthwith : Mat.5:25 28:7-8 , Mrk.9:39 , Luk.15:22 , Jhn.11:29 , Rev.2:16 3:11 11:14 22:7, 12 22:2 o. Compar., τάχειον (T, Rec. τάχιον), = cl. θᾶσσον, θᾶττον (Att..), (see Bl., § 44, 3): Jhn.13:27 20:4 , 1Ti.3:14 (T…

g5035.definition: ταχύ (neut. of ταχύς), adv. , [in LXX chiefly for מָהַר pi. ;] quickly, speedily, forthwith : Mat.5:25 28:7-8 , Mrk.9:39 , Luk.15:22 , Jhn.11:29 , Rev.2:16 3:11 11:14 22:7, 12 22:2 o. Compar., τάχειον (T, Rec. τάχιον), = cl. θᾶσσον, θᾶττον (Att..), (see Bl., § 44, 3): Jhn.13:27 20:4 , 1Ti.3:14 (T, Rec.), Heb.13:19, 23…

g5036.definition: ταχύς , -εῖα, -ύ [in LXX chiefly for מָהַר pi. ;] quick, swift, speedy : opposite to βραδύς, Ja 119.† (AS)

g5037.definition: τέ , enclitic copulative particle (= Lat. -que as καί = and, ac, atque, not very frequently in NT, more than two-thirds of the occurrences being in Ac. __1. τέ solitarium, and , denoting a closer affinity than καί between words and sentences which it connects (BL, §77, 8): Mat.28:12 , Jhn.4:42 , Act.2:33, 37 40 10:22…

g5038.definition: τεῖχος , -ους, τό [in LXX chiefly for חוֹמָה ;] a wall, esp. that about a town: Act.9:25 , 2Co.11:33 , Heb.11:30 , Rev.21:12-19 † (AS)

g5039.definition: τεκμήριον , -ου, τό (τέκμαρ, a mark, sign), [in LXX: Wis.5:4 19:13 , 3Ma.3:24 * ;] a sure sign, a positive proof : Act.1:1-26 (for exx., see MM, xxiv).† SYN. : ἔνδειγμα, q.v (AS)

g5040.definition: τεκνίον , -ου, τό (dimin. of τέκνον), a little child : as a term of endearment, in voc. pl., Jhn.13:33 , Gal.4:19 , 1Jn.2:1 Jn 2:12 Jn 2:28 Jn 3:7 Jn 3:13 Jn 4:4 Jn 5:21 .† (AS)

g5041.definition: τεκνογονέω , -ῶ to beget or bear children : 1Ti.5:14 (Anthol.).† (AS)

g5043.definition: τέκνον , -ου, τό (τίκτω), [in LXX chiefly for בֵּן, also for יֶלֶד, etc. ;] that which is begotten, born (cf. Scottish bairn ), a child of either sex: Mrk.13:12 , Luk.1:7 , Act.7:5 ; pl., Mat.7:11 , Mrk.7:27 , Luk.1:17 , Eph.6:1 , al.; τέκνα ἐπαγγελίας, Rom.9:8; τ. τῆς σαρκός, ib.; in a wider sense (as Heb. בָּנִים)…

g5044.definition: τεκνο-τροφέω , -ῶ to rear young (of bees, Arist.), to bring up children : 1Ti.5:10. † (AS)

g5045.definition: τέκτων , -ονος, ὁ [in LXX chiefly for חָרָשׁ ;] an artificer in wood, stone or metal, but esp. a carpenter (see MM, xxiv): Mat.13:55 , Mrk.6:3 .† (AS)

g5046.definition: τέλειος , -α, -ον (τέλος), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁלֵם, תָּמִים and cogn. forms ;] having reached its end, finished, mature, complete, perfect ; __1. of persons, primarily of physical development, __(a) full-grown, mature : Heb.5:14; ethically: Php.3:15; opposite to νήπιος (-άζειν), 1Co.2:6 14:20 , Eph.4:13 ; τ. καὶ…

g5047.definition: τελειότης , -ητος, ἡ (τέλειος), [in LXX: Jdg.9:16, 19 (תָּמִים), Pro.11:3 (תֻּמָּה), Wis.6:15 12:17 , Jer.2:2 * ;] perfection, completeness : Col.3:14 , Heb.6:1 (AS)

g5048.definition: τελειόω , -ῶ (τέλειος), [in LXX: Exo.29:9 , Lev.4:5 , al. (τ. χεῖρ מָלֵא pi.), 2Ki.22:26 , al. (תָּמַם), Wis.4:13 , al. (cf. Westc., He., 64) ;] __1. bring to an end, finish, accomplish, fulfil : Jhn.4:34 , Act.20:24 ; of time, Luk.2:43 , Jhn.5:36 17:4 ; pass., ἡ γραφή, Jhn.19:28. __2. to bring to maturity or…

g5049.definition: τελείως (τέλειος), adv. , [in LXX: Jdth.11:6 , 2Ma.12:42 , 3Ma.3:26 3Mac 7:22 , R* ;] completely, perfectly : 1Pe.1:13. † (AS)

g5050.definition: τελείωσις , -εως, ἡ (τελειόω), [in LXX chiefly for מִלֻּא, Exo.29:22 , al. ;] fulfilment, completion, perfection : Luk.1:45 , Heb.7:11 .† (AS)

g5051.definition: τελειωτής , -οῦ, ὁ (τελειόω), a consummator, finisher : Heb.12:2 (nowhere else).† (AS)

g5052.definition: τελεσφορέω , -ῶ (τέλος, φέρω) [in LXX: 4Ma.13:20 * ;] __(a) of plants, to bring fruit to perfection (Theophr.): Luk.8:14 __(b) of females, to bear perfect offspring (Artemid.; 4Mac, l.with).† (AS)

g5053.definition: τελευτάω , -ῶ (τελευτή), [in LXX chiefly for מוּת ;] __1. trans., to complete, finish; esp. τ. τ. αἰῶνα, τ. βίον, to complete life, to die (Æsch., Hdt., al.). __2. Intrans., to come to an end, hence, to die (Hdt., al.): Mat.2:19 9:18 22:25 , Mrk.9:48 , Luk.7:2 , Jhn.11:39 , Act.2:29 7:15 , Heb.11:22 ; Hebraistically…

g5054.definition: τελευτή , -ῆς, ἡ (τελέω), [in LXX chiefly for מוּת, מָוֶת ;] __1. a finishing. __2. an end : τ. βίου (Hdt., al.): also without βίου, the end of life, death (Hdt., Plat., al.): Mat.2:15. † (AS)

g5055.definition: τελέω , -ῶ (τέλος), [in LXX for כָּלָה, pi., etc. ;] __1. to bring to an end, complete, finish : τ. δρόμον, 2Ti.4:7; τ. λόγους, Mat.7:28 19:1 26:1 ; τ. παραβολάς, Mat.13:53; τ. πόλεις, Mat.10:23; pass., Rev.15:8 20:3, 5 20:7 ; with ptcp., Mat.11:1. __2. to execute, perform, complete, fulfil : Luk.2:39 , Act.13:29…

g5056.definition: τέλος , -ους, τό [in LXX for קֵץ, etc.; εἰς τὸ τ., chiefly for נֶצַח and cognate forms ;] __1. end : most frequently of the termination or limit of an act or state (in NT also of the end of a period of time, cl. τελευτή), Luk.1:33 , 1Co.10:11 , 2Co.3:13 , 1Pe.4:7 ; by meton., of one who makes an end, Rom.10:4; ἕως…

g5057.definition: τελώνης , -ου, ὁ (τέλος, ὠνέομαι) __1. a farmer of taxes (Let. publicanus). __2. A subordinate of the former, who collected taxes or tolls in a particular district, a tax-gatherer (EV, publican): Mat.5:46 10:3 , Luk.3:12 5:27, 29 7:29 18:10-11, 13 ; pl., τ. κ. ἁμαρτωλοί, Mat.9:10-11 11:19 , Mrk.2:15-16 , Luk.5:30 7:34…

g5058.definition: τελώνιον , -ου, τό (τελώνης), a custom house (so in M Gr. ), tollhouse, place of toll: Mat.9:9 , Mrk.2:14 , Luk.5:27 .† (AS)

g5059.definition: τέρας , -ατος, τό [in LXX chiefly for מוֹפֵת ;] a wonder, marvel : in NT always pl., τ. κ. σημεῖα, Mat.24:24 , al. (see: σημεῖον) (AS)

g5062.definition: τεσσεράκοντα (Rec. τεσσαρ-, v, WH, App. , 150; M, Pr. , 45 f.; Thackeray, Gr. , 62 f., 73 f.), οἱ, αἱ, τά, indecl., forty : Mat.4:2 , Mrk.1:13 , Luk.4:2 , Jhn.2:20 , Act.1:3 , al (AS)

g5063.definition: τεσσερακονταετίς (Τ, -έτης; Rec. τεσσαρ-, see supr.), -ές of forty years, forty years old : Act.7:23 13:18 .† (AS)

g5064.definition: τέσσαρες (and Ion. and late -ερεν, and late accusative -εν; see WH, App. , 150; M, Pr. , 36, 45 f.), οἱ, αἱ, -αρα, τά, genitive, -ων, four : Mat.24:31 , Mrk.2:3 , Luk.2:37 , Jhn.11:17 19:23 , Act.10:11 , Rev.4:4 , 6, al (AS)

g5066.definition: τεταρταῖος , -α, -ον (τέταρτος), [in LXX: 2Ki.3:4 A (רְבִיעִי) * ;] of or on the fourth day : τ. εἶναι (Hdt., τ. γενέσθαι), to be four days dead, Jhn.11:39. † (AS)

g5067.definition: τέταρτος , -η, -ον [in LXX chiefly for רְבִיעִי ;] fourth : Mat.14:25 , Mrk.6:48 , Act.10:30 , Rev.4:7 6:7-8 8:12 16:8 21:19 .† (AS)

g5069.definition: τετράδιον , ου, τό a quarternion, a group of four : στρατιωτῶν, Act.12:4 (Philo). (AS)

g5070.definition: τετρακισ-χίλιοι , -αι, -α four thousand : Mat.15:38 16:10 , Mrk.8:9, 20 , Act.21:38 .† (AS)

g5072.definition: τετράμηνος , -ον [in LXX (neut.): Jdg.19:2 A Jdg.20:47 A (עַרְבָּעָה חֳדָשִׁים ) * ;] of four months, four months ; as subst., τ. (sc. ὥρα, but neut. in Rec.), Jhn.4:35 (Thuc., al.).† (AS)

g5170.definition: Τρύφαινα , -ης, ἡ Tryphæna : Rom.16:12 (see Lft., Phi., 175 f.; MM, xxv).† (AS)

g5171.definition: τρυφάω , -ῶ (τρυφή), [in LXX: Neh.9:25 (עָדַן hithp.), Isa.66:11 (עָנַג hithp.), Sir.14:4 * ;] to live daintily, luxuriously, to fare sumptuously : Jas.5:5 (cf. ἐν-τρυφάω).† SYN. : σπαταλάω (which see), στρηνιάω (AS)

g5172.definition: τρυφή , -ῆς, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for עָדַן ;] softness, daintiness, luxuriousness : Luk.7:25 , 2Pe.2:13 .† (AS)

g5173.definition: Τρυφῶσα , -ης, ἡ, ς, ἡ Tryphosa : Rom.16:12 (see Lft., Phi., 175 f.).† (AS)

g5174.definition: Τρῳάς (Rec. Τρω-), -άδος, ἡ Troas, a city near the Hellespont : Act.16:8, 11 20:5-6 , 2Co.2:12 , 2Ti.4:13 .† (AS)

g5175.definition: Τρωγύλλιον (also written -γύλιον, -γίλιον, -ία, see Bl., § 6, 3), -ου Trogyllium, a city of Ionia : Act.20:15 (WH, txt., R, txt., om.).† (AS)

g5177.definition: τυγχάνω [in LXX: Deu.19:5 (מָצָא), Job.3:21 7:2 17:1 , Pro.30:23 (without definite Heb. equiv.), Wis.15:19 , 1Ma.11:42 , 3Ma.3:7 , al. ;] __I. g5178.definition: τυμπανίζω (τύμπανον, a kettle-drum), [in LXX: 1Ki.21:13 (14) (17 pi?) * ;] __1. to beat a drum. __2. to torture by beating, beat to death (cf. Westc. on He, l.with): pass., Heb.11:35. † (AS)

g5179.definition: τύπος , -ου, ὁ (τύπτω), [in LXX: Exo.25:39 (40) (תַּבְנִית), Amo.5:26 , 3Ma.3:30 , 4Ma.6:19 * ;] __1. the mark of a blow : τῶν ἥλων, Jhn.20:25. __2. An impression, impress, the stamp made by a die; hence, a figure, image : Act.7:43 (LXX). __3. form (Plat.): Rom.6:17; the sense or substance of a letter (3Mac, l.with)…

g5180.definition: τύπτω [in LXX chiefly for hi. ;] to strike, smite, beat : with accusative, Mat.24:49 , Mrk.15:19 , Luk.12:45 , Act.18:17 21:32 23:2-3 ; of mourners, τὰ στήθη, Luk.18:13 23:48 ; ἐπὶ τ. σιαγόνα, Luk.6:29; εἰς τ. κεφαλήν, Mat.27:30. g5184.definition: Τύρος , -ου, ἡ Tyre, a maritime city of Phænicia : Mrk.7:31 , Act.21:3 , 7; Τ. κ, Σιδών, Mat.11:21-22 15:21 , Mrk.3:8 7:24 , Luk.6:17 10:13-14 .† (AS)

g5185.definition: τυφλός , -ή, -όν [in LXX for עִוֵּר ;] blind : as subst., ὁ τ., Mat.9:27 , Mrk.8:22 , Luk.4:18 " (LXX), Jhn.5:3 , al. Metaphorical: Mat.15:14 23:16-26 , Jhn.9:39-41 , Rom.2:19 , 2Pe.1:9 , Rev.3:17 . (AS)

g5187.definition: τυφόω , -ῶ (τῦφος, smoke; metaphorically, conceit), prop., to wrap in smoke; used only metaphorically, to puff up, becloud with pride : pass., 1Ti.3:6 6:4 , 2Ti.3:4 (Dem., Arist., al.).† (AS)

g5189.definition: τυφωνικός , -ή, -όν (τῦφων, a hurricane, typhoon) tempestuous : Act.27:14. † (AS)

g5190.definition: τύχικος (T , Rec., Τυχικός), -ου, ὁ Tychicus : Act.20:4 , Eph.6:21 , Col.4:7 , 2Ti.4:12 , Tit.3:12 .† (AS)

g5192.definition: ὑακίνθος , -ου, ό [in LXX chiefly for תְּכֵלֶת ;] hyacinth ; __(a) in cl., a flower, prob. the dark blue iris; __(b) in late writers, a precious stone of the same colour, perhaps the sapphire : Rev.21:20 (Phil., FlJ, al.).† (AS)

g5194.definition: ὕαλος , -ου, ὁ [in LXX: Job.28:17 (זְכוּכִית) * ;] __1. (Hdt.) a clear transparent stone. __2. (from Plat. on) glass: Rev.21:18, 21 .† (AS)

g5195.definition: ὑβρίζω (ὕβρις), [in LXX for גֵּאֶה, etc. ;] __1. intrans., to wax wanton, run riot. __2. Trans., to outrage, insult, treat insolently : with accusative of person(s), Mat.22:6 , Luk.11:45 18:32 , Act.14:5 , 1Th.2:2 .† (AS)

g5196.definition: ὕβρις , -εως, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for גָּאוֹן and cogn. forms ;] __1. wantonness, insolence. __2. = ὕβρισμα, an act of wanton violence, an outrage, injury : 2Co.12:10; metaphorically, of a loss by sea (find.), Act.27:10, 21 (see MM, xxv).† (AS)

g5197.definition: ὑβριστής , -οῦ, ὁ (ὑβρίζω), [in LXX chiefly for גֵּאֶה ;] a violent, insolent man : Rom.1:20 , 1Ti.1:13 (EV, injurious).† SYN. : ἀλαζών, ὑπερήφανος, see Tr., Syn. , § xxix (AS)

g5198.definition: ὑγιαίνω (ὑγιής), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁלוֹם, and frequently in To ;] to be sound, healthy, in good health : Luk.5:31 7:10 15:27 , 3Jo.2 . In Past. g5199.definition: ὑγιής , -ές, accusative, ὑγιῆ (Attic usually -ιᾶ), [in LXX for חַי, etc. ;] sound, whole, healthy : Mat.12:13 15:31 , Jhn.5:[4], 6, 9, 11, 14, 15 7:23, Act.4:10 ; before ἀπό, Mrk.5:34; of words, opinions, etc. (as in cl.), metaphorically, λόγος, Tit.2:8. † (AS)

g5200.definition: ὑγρός , -ά, -όν, [in LXX: Jdg.16:7 ,8 (לַח), Job.8:16 (רָשׂב), Sir.39:13 wet, moist , opposite to ξηρός: of wood, sappy, green : Luk.23:31. † (AS)

g5202.definition: ὑδροποτίω , -ῶ (ὕδωρ, πίνω), [in LXX: Dan LXX 1:12 שָׁתָה מַיִם) * ;] to drink water, opposite to οἴνῳ χρῆσθαι: 1Ti.5:23 (Hdt., i, 71; Plat., Rep., 561 with, al.).† (AS)

g5207.definition: υἱός , -οῦ, ὁ, [in LXX very frequently and nearly always for בֵּן, Gen.4:17 , al.; for בַּר, Dan LXX TH 7:13 , al.; etc. ;], a son ; __1. in the ordinary sense : Mat.10:37 , Mrk.9:17 , Luk.1:13 , al. mult.; omitted with the art. of origin (WM, §30, 3; Bl., §35, 2), τὸν τοῦ Ἰεσσαί, Act.13:22 (LXX); also with genitive…

g5234.definition: ὑπερβαλλόντως [in LXX: Job.15:11 א B (†) * ;] above measure : 2Co.11:23. † (AS)

g5242.definition: ὑπερ-έχω [in LXX: Gen.25:23 (אָמַץ), Exo.26:13 (עֲדַף), Sir.36:7 , al. ;] __1. trans., to hold over or above. __2. Intrans. g5243.definition: ὑπερηφανία , -ας, ἡ (ὑπερήφανος, which see), [in LXX chiefly for גָּאוֹן and cogn. forms ;] haughtiness, arrogance, disdain : Mrk.7:22 (Plat., Xen.).† (AS)

g5262.definition: ὑπό-δειγμα , -τος, τό (ὑποδείκνυμι), [in LXX: Eze.42:15 , Sir.44:16 , 2Ma.6:28 2Mac 6:31 , 4Ma.17:23 * ;] used by later writers (Xen. onwards) for παράδειγμα (see Rutherford, NPhr. , 62), __(a) a figure, copy : Heb.8:5 9:23 ; __(b) an example : for imitation, Jhn.13:15 , Jas.5:10 ; for warning, Heb.4:11 , 2Pe.2:6 .†…

g5263.definition: ὑπο-δείκνυμι [in LXX for נָגַד hi., etc. ;] __1. to show secretly. __2. to show by tracing out; hence, generally, to teach, make known : with dative of person(s), Luk.6:47 12:5 , Act.9:16 ; id. with inf., Mat.3:7 , Luk.3:7 ; before, ὅτι, Act.20:35. † (AS)

g5264.definition: ὑπο-δέχομαι [in LXX: Tob.7:8-9 Jdth.13:13 A, 1Ma.16:15 , 4Ma.13:17 * ;] to receive under one's roof, receive as a guest, entertain hospitably : with accusative of person(s), Luk.19:6 , Act.17:7 , Jas.2:25 ; εἰς τ. οἶκον, Luk.10:38 (see MM, xxv).† (AS)

g5265.definition: ὑπο-δέω [in LXX: 2Ch.28:15 , Eze.16:10 (נָעַל) * ;] to blind under, esp. of foot gear. Most frequently in mid, and pass. with accusative; __(a) of the foot, ὑποδησάμενοι τ. πόδας, your feet shod : Eph.6:15; __(b) of that which is put on, σανδάλια : Mrk.6:9 , Act.12:8 .† (AS)

g5266.definition: ὑπόδημα , -τος, τό (ὑποδέω), [in LXX for נָעַל ;] a sole bound under the foot, a sandal : Mat.3:11 10:10 , Mrk.1:7 , Luk.3:16 10:4 15:22 22:35 , Jhn.1:27 ; τ. ποδῶν, Act.7:33 (LXX) Act.13:25. † SYN. : σανδάλιον, q.v (AS)

g5268.definition: ὑπο-ζύγιος , -α, -ον [in LXX for חֲמוֹר ;] under the yoke ; as subst., τ . (Hdt., al.), a beast of burden; colloq., an ass (see Deiss., BS, 160 f.), and so always in LXX and NT: Mat.21:5 (LXX), 2Pe.2:16. † (AS)

g5269.definition: ὑπο-ζώννυμι [in LXX: 2Ma.3:19 * ;] to undergird (Hdt., al.; ὑπὸ τ. μάστους, 2Mac, l.with); of a ship, to undergird or frap : Act.27:17 (see DB , ext. 367a).† (AS)

g5270.definition: ύπο-κάτω comp. adv. (see M, Pr. , 99), [in LXX chiefly for תַּחַת ;] below, under : as prep. with genitive, Mat.22:44 , Mrk.6:11 7:28 12:36 (Rec., R, txt., ὑποπόδιον, as in LXX), Luk.8:16 , Jhn.1:51 , Heb.2:8 " (LXX), Rev.5:3, 13 6:9 12:1 .† (AS)

g5271.definition: ὑπο-κρίνομαι [in LXX: ( Job.40:2 ) אּ1 (AB אּ2 ἀπο-, עָנָה), Sir.1:29 35:15 (32:15) Sir.36:2 (33:2), 2Ma.5:25 2Mac 6:21 2Mac 6:24 , 4Ma.6:15 4Mac 6:17 * ;] __1. = Att.. ἀποκρίνομαι (which see), to answer, reply (Hom., Hdt., al.). __2. to answer on the stage, play apart (Arist., al.). Metaphorical, to feign, pretend…

g5272.definition: ὑπό-κρισις , -εως, ἡ (ὑποκρίνομαι, which see) [in LXX: 2Ma.6:25 * ;] __1. a reply, answer (Hdt.). __2. play-acting (Arist., Polyb., al.). Metaphorical, pretence, hypocrisy : Mat.23:28 , Mrk.12:15 , Luk.12:1 , Gal.2:13 , 1Ti.4:2 , 1Pe.2:1 (Polyb., Pss Sng.4:7 ).† (AS)

g5273.definition: ὑπο-κριτής , -οῦ, ὁ (ὑποκρίνομαι, which see) [in LXX Job.34:30 36:13 (חָנֵף) * ;] __1. one who answers, an interpreter (Plat.). __2. a stage player, actor (Plut., Xen., al.). Metaphorical (in LXX and NT), a pretender, dissembler, hypocrite : Mat.6:2, 5 6:16 7:5 15:7 22:18 23:13-15 24:51 , Mrk.7:6 Luk.6:42 12:56 13:15…

g5274.definition: ὑπο-λαμβάνω [in LXX: Job.2:4 4:1 and frequently (עָנָה), Psa.48:9 (דָּמָה pi.), Tob.6:17 , Wis.17:2 , 3Ma.3:8 3Mac 3:11 , al. ;] __1. to take or bear up (by supporting from beneath): with accusative of person(s), Act.1:9. __2. to receive, welcome, entertain (Xen.): III Jn 8 . __3. to catch up in speech (Hdt., al.; Jb…

g5275.definition: ὑπο-λείπω [in LXX chiefly (pass.) for יָתַר ni., שָׁאַר ni. ;] to leave remaining (Hom., Thuc., al.): pass., of survivors, Rom.11:3. † (AS)

g5276.definition: ὑπολήνιον , -ου, τό (ὑπό, ληνός), [in LXX: Jol.3:13 (4:13), Hag.2:17 , (16), Zec.14:10 , Isa.16:10 (יֶקֶב) * ;] a vessel or trough beneath a winepress to receive the juice (RV, a pit for the winepress): Mrk.12:1 (see Swete, in l, and cf. ληνός).† (AS)

g5277.definition: ὑπο-λιμτάνω collat. form of ὑπολείπω, to leave behind : 1Pe.2:21. † (AS)

g5278.definition: ὑπο-μένω [in LXX chiefly for קָוָה, also for יָחַל hi., etc. ;] __1. in-trans., to stay behind : before ἐν, Luk.2:43; ἐκεῖ, Act.17:14. __2. Trans., __(a) with accusative, to await, wait for : Rom.8:24 (Hom., Hdt., Xen., al.); __(b) of things, to bear patiently, endure : absol., Mat.10:22 24:13 , Mrk.13:13 , 2Ti.2:12…

g5279.definition: ὑπο-μιμνήσκω [in LXX: 3Ki.4:3 B ( hi.), Wis.12:1 18:22 , 4Ma.18:14 * ;] to cause one to remember, put one in mind or remind one of : with accusative of thing(s), 2Ti.2:14 , 3Jn.10 ; with dupl. accusative (Thus., al.), Jhn.14:26; with accusative of person(s), before περί, 2Pe.1:12; id., before ὅτι, Ju 5 ; with inf.…

g5280.definition: ὑπόμινησις , -εως, ἡ (ὑπομιμνήσκω) [in LXX: Psa.71:6 א (תְּהִלָּה), Wis.16:11 , 2Ma.6:17 * ;] a reminding, reminder : ἐν ὑ., 2Pe.1:13 3:1 ; with genitive, 2Ti.1:5. † (AS)

g5281.definition: ὑπο-μονή , -ῆς, ἡ (ὑπομένω) [in LXX for מִקְוֶה and cogn. forms; frequently in 4Mac ;] __1. a remaining behind (Arist.). __2. patient enduring, endurance : Luk.8:15 21:19 , Rom.5:3-4 15:4-5 , 2Co.6:4 12:12 , Col.1:11 , 2Th.1:4 , 1Ti.6:11 , 2Ti.3:10 , Tit.2:2 , Heb.10:36 , Jas.1:3-4 5:11 , 2Pe.1:6 , Rev.2:2-3, 19 13:10…

g5282.definition: ὑπο νοέω , -ῶ [in LXX: Da TH Dan.7:25 (סְבַר), Tob.8:16 , Jdth.14:14 , Sir.23:21 * ;] to suspect, conjecture : Act.25:18; with accusative and inf., Act.13:25 27:27 .† (AS)

g5283.definition: ὑπόνοια , -ας, ἡ (ὑπονοέω), [in LXX: Dan LXX 4:16, 32 5:6 (רַעְיוֹן), Sir 3:34 * ;] a suspicion : 1Ti.6:4. † (AS)

g5284.definition: ὑπο-πλέω to sail under, i.e. under the lee of: with accusative, Act.27:4 , 7.† (AS)

g5285.definition: ὑπο-πνέω __1. to blow underneath (Arist.). __2. to blow gently : Act.27:13. † (AS)

g5286.definition: ὑποπόδιον , -ου, τό (ὑπό, πούς), [in LXX: Psa.99:5 110:1 , Isa.66:1 , La 2:1 (הֲדֹם) * ;] a footstool (= cl. θρᾶνος): Jas.2:3; metaphorically, Mat.5:35 , Mrk.12:36 (ὑποκάτω, WH, R, mg.), Luk.20:43 , Act.2:35 7:49 , Heb.1:13 10:13 (all, except Mt, l.with, from LXX, Psa.110:1 , Isa.66:1 ) (for exx., see Deiss., BS…

g5287.definition: ὑπό-στασις , -εως, ἡ (ὑφίστημι, to set under, stand under, support) [in LXX for מַצָּב ( 1Ki.13:23 14:4 B), תִּקְוָה ( Rut.1:12 , Eze.19:5 ), etc., also in Wis.16:21 ;] __1. a support, base or foundation (in various senses). __2. substance (Arist., al.; opposite to φαντασία, ἔμφασις): Heb.1:3 __3. steadiness, firmness…

g5289.definition: ὑπο-στολή , -ῆς, ἡ (ὑποστέλλω), __1. a letting down, lowering (Plut.). __2. a shrinking back (Hesych.): οὐκ ἐσμὲν ὑποστολῆς (on the genitive, see Bl., § 35, 2), Heb.10:39. † (AS)

g5292.definition: ὑπο-ταγή , -ῆς, ἡ [in LXX: Wis.18:16 A * ;] subjection : 2Co.9:13 , Gal.2:5. 1Ti.2:11 3:4 .† (AS)

g5293.definition: ὑπο-τάσσω [in LXX for דָבַר hi., דָּמַם, שׂוּם, שִׁית, etc. ;] __1. as a military term, to place or rank under (Polyb.). __2. to subject, put in subjection : 1Co.15:27 , Php.3:21 , Heb.2:5 , 8; pass., Rom.8:20 , 1Co.15:27-28 , 1Pe.3:22 , Eph.1:22 . g5307.definition: ὑφαντός , -ή, -όν (ὑφαίνω), [in LXX chiefly for חָשַׁב ;] woven : Jhn.19:23. † ὑφαίνω, [in LXX for אָרַג, etc. ;] to weave : Luk.12:27 , T, WH, mg.† (AS)

g5308.definition: ὑψηλός , -ή, -όν [in LXX chiefly for בָּמָה, also for בָּמָה, רוּם, etc. ;] high, lofty : ὄρος, Mat.4:8 17:1 , Mrk.9:2 , Rev.21:10 ; τεῖχος, Rev.21:12; μετὰ βραχίονος., figuratively, Act.13:17 (cf. g5312.definition: ὑψόω , -ῶ (ὕψος), [in LXX chiefly for רוּם, also for גָּבַהּ, נָשָׂא, etc. ;] to lift or raise up : with accusative, Jhn.3:14 8:28 12:32, 34 ; ἕως τ. οὐρανοῦ, figuratively, pass., Mat.11:23 , Luk.10:15 . g5313.definition: ὕψωμα , -τος, τό [in LXX: Job.24:24 (†), Jdth.10:8 13:4 15:9 * ;] __(a) height : Rom.8:39; __(b) that which is lifted up, a barrier : 2Co.10:5. † (AS)

g5314.definition: φάγος , -ου, ὁ (φαγεῖν, see: ἐσθίω) a glutton : Mat.11:19 , Luk.7:34 .† (AS)

Absol., to give light, shine (Hom., Plat., al.): Jhn.1:5 5:35 , 2Pe.1:19 , 1Jn.2:8 , Rev.1:16 8:12 18:23 21:23 . __II. Pass., to come to light, appear, be manifest : Mat.2:7 13:26 24:27…

g5317.definition: Φάλεκ (T, Rec. Φαλέκ, L, mg., Φάλεγ), ὁ indecl. (Heb. D, Ge 1116), Peleg : Luk.3:35. † (AS)

g5318.definition: φανερός , -ά, -όν (φαίνομαι) [in LXX: Deu.29:29 (28) (גָּלָה ni.), Pro.14:4 , Sir.6:22 , al. ;] open to sight, visible, manifest : Gal.5:19; before ἐν, Rom.1:19 , 1Jn.3:10 ; with dative of person(s), Act.4:16 7:13 , 1Ti.4:15 ; φ. γίνεσθαι (in LXX for בָּחַן ni., Gen.42:16 ), Mrk.6:14 , Luk.8:17 , 1Co.3:13 14:25 ; id.…

g5320.definition: φανερῶς adv. (φανερός), [in LXX: 2Ma.3:28 * ;] __(a) manifestly, openly : Mrk.1:45; opposite to ἐν κρυπτῷ„ Jhn.7:10; __(b) clearly : Act.10:3 ( 2Ma.3:28 ).† (AS)

g5321.definition: φανέρωσις , -εως, ἡ (φανερόω), [in LXX as seel. for δήλωσις אוּרִים), Lev.8:8 , Cod. Ven. (Thayer, see word) * ;] manifestation : 1Co.12:7 , 2Co.4:2 .† (AS)

g5322.definition: φανός , -οῦ, ὁ (φαίνω), a torch or lantern (see Rutherford, NPhr. , 131 f.): Jhn.18:3. † SYN. : see: λαμπάς (AS)

g5323.definition: Φανουήλ , ὁ indecl. (Heb. פְּנוּאֵל), Phanuel : Luk.2:36. † (AS)

g5325.definition: φαντασία , -ας, ἡ (φαντάζω), [in LXX: Zec.10:1 (חֲזִיז), חֲזִיז), Hab.2:18-19 3:10 , Wis.18:17 * ;] __1. as philos. term, __(a) imagination ; __(b) = φάντασμα (Plat., Arist.). __2. In later writers (Polyb., al.), show, display : Act.25:23. † (AS)
