g5433.definition: φρυάσσω (so Ps, l.with, NT; elsewhere depon., φρυάσσομαι, Att.. -ττ-), [in LXX: Psa.2:1 (רָגַשׁ), 2Ma.7:34 R, 3Ma.2:2 * ;] prop., of horses, to neigh, whinny and prance (Plut., al.). Metaphorical, to be wanton, insolent : Act.4:25 (LXX).† (AS)

g5434.definition: φρύγανον , -ου, τό (φρύγω, to parch), [in LXX chiefly for קַשׁ, also for חָרוּל, etc. ;] a dry stick : pl., brushwood : Act.28:3. † (AS)

g5435.definition: φρυγία , -ας, ἡ (prop., the adj., Φρυγίος, -α, -ον; sc. γῆ, χώρα), Phrygia, a region of Asia Minor : Act.2:10; Φ. καὶ Γαλατικὴ χώρα (Γ. χ. κ. Φ.), Act.16:6 18:23 (on these phrases see DB , i, 89 f.; CGT, Gal. , xxii f.).† (AS)

g5437.definition: φυγή , -ῆς, ἡ (φεύγω), [in LXX chiefly for מָנוֹס and cogn. forms ;] flight : Mat.24:20. † (AS)

g5438.definition: φυλακή , -ῆς, ἡ (φυλάσσω) [in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁמֶרֶת and cogn. forms, also for כֶּלֶא etc. ;] __(a) actively, a guarding, guard, watch (Hom., Plat., Xen., al.): cogn. accusative, φυλάσσειν φυλακάς, to keep watch, Luk.2:8; __(b) of those who keep watch (as also Lat. custodia), a guard; pl., sentinels, a guard…

g5439.definition: φυλακίζω [in LXX: Wis.18:4 * ;] to imprison : Act.22:19. † (AS)

g5440.definition: φυλακτήριον , -ου, τό __1. an outpost, fortification (Thuc., al.). __2. a safeguard (Plat.). __3. an amulet (Plut., al.); in NT for the Talmudic תְּפִלִּין, a prayer fillet, a phylactery, a small strip of parchment on which portions of the law were written and worn on the forehead and next the heart (cf. Exo.13:16 )…

g5441.definition: φύλαξ , -ακος, ὁ (φυλάσσω), [in LXX for שָׁמַר, צוּר ;] a guard, keeper : Act.5:23 12:6, 19 .† (AS)

g5442.definition: φυλάσσω [in LXX chiefly and very frequently for שָׁמַר, also for נָצַר, etc. ;] to guard, watch ; __(a) to guard or watch : with cogn. accusative, φυλακάς, Luk.2:8; with accusative of person(s), Act.12:4 28:16 ; pass., Luk.8:29 , Act.23:35 ; with accusative of thing(s), Act.22:20; __(b) to guard or protect : with…

g5443.definition: φυλή , ῆς, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for; מַטֶּה, also for שֵׁבֶט, מִשְׁפָּחָה, etc. ;] a body of men united by kinship or habitation, a clan or tribe : of the tribes of Israel, Mat.19:28 , Luk.2:36 22:30 , Act.13:21 , Rom.11:1 , Php.3:5 , Heb.7:13-14 , Jas.1:1 , Rev.5:5 7:4-8 21:12 ; of the tribes of the earth, the peoples…

g5444.definition: φύλλον , -ου, τό [in LXX chiefly for עָלֶה ;] a leaf : Mat.21:19 24:32 , Mrk.11:13 13:28 , Rev.22:2 .† (AS)

g5445.definition: φύραμα , -τος, τό (φυράω, to mix), [in LXX: Exo.8:3 ( Exo.7:28 ) Exo.12:34 (מִשְׁאֶרֶת), מִשְׁאֶרֶת), Num.15:20-21 (עֲרִיסָה) * ;] that which is mixed or kneaded, a lump : of dough, Rom.11:16 , 1Co.5:6-7 , Gal.5:9 ; of clay, Rom.9:21. † (AS)

g5446.definition: φυσικός , -ή, -όν (ψύσις), natural __(a) produced by nature, innate (Xen., Arist., al.); __(b) according to nature (Arist., Diod., al.): opposite to παρὰ φύσιν, Rom.1:26-27; __(with) governed by mere natural instinct (of. Plut., Mor., 706 A): ζῷα γεγεννημένα φ. (RV, born mere animals; Mayor, born creatures of…

g5447.definition: φυσικῶς adv. , naturally, by nature : Ju 10 .† (AS)

g5448.definition: φυσιόω , -ῶ (φῦσα, bellows), = cl. φυσάω, to puff or blow up, inflate. Metaphorical, to puff up, make proud : 1Co.8:1. Pass., to be puffed up with pride : 1Co.4:18-19 5:2 13:4 ; before ὑπό, Col.2:18; before ὑπὲρ . . . κατά, 1Co.4:6 (on the form of the subjc., see M, Pr. , 54; Bl., § 22, 3).† (AS)

g5449.definition: φύσις , -εως, ἡ (φύω) [in LXX: Wis.7:20 13:1 19:20 אΑ, 3Ma.3:29 , 4Ma.1:20 4Mac 5:7-8 4Mac 5:25 4Mac 13:27 4Mac 15:13 4Mac 15:25 4Mac 16:3 * ;] nature, i.e., __(a) the nature (natural powers or constitution) of a person or thing: Jas.3:7 , 2Pe.1:4 ; τέκνα φυσει ὀργῆς, Eph.2:3; __(b) origin, birth (Soph., Xen., al.)…

g5450.definition: φυσίωσις , -εως, ἡ (φυσιόω), a puffing up, swelling with pride : pl., 2Co.12:20. † (AS)

g5452.definition: φυτεύω (φυτόν, a plant, φύω), [in LXX chiefly for נָטַע, also for שָׁתַל, etc. ;] to plant : Luk.17:28 , 1Co.3:6-8 ; with accusative, φυτείαν, Mat.15:13; ἀμπελῶνα, Mat.21:33 , Mrk.12:1 , Luk.20:9 , 1Co.9:7 ; pass., before ἐν, Luk.13:6 17:6 .† (AS)

g5453.definition: φύω [in LXX: Pro.26:9 , Eze.37:8 (עָלָה), etc. ;] __1. trans., to bring forth, produce (of men, to beget); pass., to spring up, grow : Luk.8:6 , 8. __2. Intrans., in 2 aor., pf., plpf., and rarely in present (see LS, see word, A, II.), to spring up : Heb.12:15. † (AS)

g5454.definition: φωλεός , -οῦ ὁ a hole, den, lair : Mat.8:20 , Luk.9:58 .† (AS)

g5455.definition: φωνέω , -ῶ (φωνή), [in LXX for קָרָא ( Jer.17:11 , al.), etc. ;] __I. Intrans. __1. Of persons, to call out, cry out, speak aloud : Luk.8:8; φωνῇ μεγάλῃ, Mrk.1:26 , Act.16:28 ; ἐφώνησε (φωνῇ μεγάλῇ) λέγων, Luk.8:54 , Rev.14:18 ; φωνήσαντες ἐπύθοντο, Act.10:18. __2. Of the cries of animals (rarely in cl.; Isa.38:14…

g5456.definition: φωνή , -ῆς, ἡ, [in LXX chiefly and very frequently for קוֹל ;] a voice ; __(a) prop., of persons, Mat.2:18 (LXX), al.; φ. αἴρειν (ἐπαίρειν), Luk.17:13 , Act.2:14 , al.; φ. μεγάλῃ εἰπεῖν (λέγειν, φωνεῖν, etc.), Luk.8:28 , Act.7:57 , Rev.5:12 , al.; γίνεται (ἔρχεται) φ. ἐκ τ. οὐρανῶν (ἐξ οὐρανοῦ), Mrk.1:11 , Luk.3:22…

g5457.definition: φῶς (Att.. contr. from φάος; φάω), genitive, φωτός, τό, [in LXX chiefly for אוֹר ;] light (opposite to τὸ σκότος, ἡ σκοτία): Mat.17:2 , 5, Jhn.11:9-10 , 2Co.4:6 ; ἡλίου, Rev.22:5; of a lamp, Luk.8:16 11:33 , Jhn.5:35 , Rev.18:23 ; of a supernatural heavenly light, Act.9:3 12:7 22:6, 9 22:11 26:13 ; hence, ἄγγελος…

g5458.definition: φωστήρ , -ῆρος, ὁ (φῶς), [in LXX: Gen.1:14, 16 (מָאוֹר), Dan LXX 12:3 (זֹהַר), I Est.8:79 , Wis.13:2 , Sir.43:7 * ;] a luminary, light : Php.2:15 , Rev.21:11 .† SYN. : φέγγος, φῶς (AS)

g5459.definition: φωσ-φόρος , -ον (φῶς, φέρω), light-bringing ; as subst., ὁ φ., the morning star (Plat., al.; cf. ἐωσφόρος, Isa.14:12 , Job.3:9 , Psa.110:3 ): metaphorically, 2Pe.1:19 (see Mayor, in l).† (AS)

g5460.definition: φωτεινός (WH , φωτινός), ή, όν (φῶς), [in LXX: Sir.17:31 23:19 * ;] bright, light : νεφέλη, Mat.17:5; opposite to σκοτεινός, Mat.6:22 , Luk.11:34, 36 .† (AS)

g5461.definition: φωτίζω (φῶς) [in LXX for אוֹר hi, יָרָה hi., etc. ;] __1. intrans., to shine, give light (Arist., Plut., a1.): before ἐπί, Rev.22:5. __2. Trans. __(a) to illumine, enlighten (Diod., Plut., al.): with accusative, Luk.11:36 , Rev.21:23 ; pass., Rev.18:1. Metaphorical, of spiritual enlightenment ( Psa.119:130 , Sir.45:17…

g5462.definition: φωτισμός , -οῦ, ὁ (φωτίζω) [in LXX: Job.3:9 , Psa.27:1 44:3 78:14 139:11 (אוֹר), Psa.89:8 (מָאוֹר) * ;] illumination, light : metaphorically, 1Co.4:4 4:6 .† (AS)

g5463.definition: χαίρω [in LXX for שָׂמַח ( Gen.45:16 , al.), גִּיל ( Pro.2:14 , al.), etc.; inf., as greeting (see infr.), Isa.48:22 57:21 שָׁלוֹם), 1Ma.10:18 , 2Ma.1:1 and frequently in these books ;] __1. to rejoice, be glad : Mrk.14:11 , Luk.15:5, 32 19:6, 37 22:5 23:8 , Jhn.8:56 20:20 , Act.5:41 8:39 11:23 13:48 , 2Co.6:10 7:7…

g5464.definition: χάλαζα , -ης, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for בָּרָד ;] hail : Rev.8:7 11:19 16:21 .† (AS)

g5465.definition: χαλάω , -ῶ [in LXX: ( Jer.38:6 ) (שָׁלַח pi.), etc. ;] __(a) to slacken, loosen ; __(b) to let loose, let go ; __(with) to lower, let down : with accusative of thing(s), Mrk.2:4 , Luk.5:4-5 , Act.9:25 27:17, 30 ; with accusative of person(s) (cf. Je, l.with), pass., 2Co.11:33. † (AS)

g5466.definition: Χαλδαῖος , -ου, ὁ a Chaldæan : γῆ Χαλδαίων, Act.7:4. † (AS)

g5468.definition: χαλιναγωγέω , -ῶ (χαλινός, ἄγω), to lead with a bridle ; metaphorically, to bridle, restrain : with accusative, γλῶσσαν, Jas.1:26; σῶμα, Jas.3:2. † (AS)

g5469.definition: χαλινός , -οῦ, ὁ [in LXX chiefly for מֶתֶג ;] a bridle : Jas.3:3 , Rev.14:20 .† (AS)

g5471.definition: χαλκεύς , -έως, ὁ (χαλκός), [in LXX for חָרָשׁ, etc. ;] a worker, in metal, esp. a copper-smith: 2Ti.4:14. † (AS)

g5472.definition: χαλκηδών , -όνος, ὁ chalcedony, "supposed to denote a green silicate of copper found in the mines near Chalcedon " (Swete): Rev.21:19. † (AS)

g5474.definition: χαλκο-λίβανον , -ου, τό chalcolibanus, probably "a mixed metal of great brilliance" (Swete): Rev.1:15 2:18 (RV, burnished brass).† (AS)

g5475.definition: χαλκός , -oῦ, ὁ [in LXX chiefly for נְחֹשֶׁת ;] copper : 1Co.13:1 , Rev.18:12 ; by meton., of copper coin, Mat.10:9 , Mrk.6:8 12:41 .† (AS)

g5476.definition: χαμαί adv. , on or to the ground : Jhn.9:6 18:6 .† (AS)

g5477.definition: Χαναάν , ἡ indecl. (Heb. כְּנַעַן), Canaan : Act.7:11; γῆ Χ., Act.13:19. † (AS)

g5479.definition: χαρά , -ᾶς, ἡ (χαίρω), [in LXX for שִׂמְחָה, שָׂשׂוֹן, etc. ;] joy, delight : Luk.1:14 15:7, 10 , Jhn.15:11 16:22, 24 17:13 , Act.8:8 , 2Co.1:24 7:13 8:2 , Gal.5:22 , Col.1:11 , Php.2:2 , 1Jn.1:4 , 2Jn.12 ; opposite to κατήφεια, Jas.4:9; to λύπη, Jhn.16:20; χ. τῆς πίστεως, Php.1:25; ἀγαλλιᾶσθαι (χαίρειν, which see)…

g5480.definition: χάραγμα , -τος, τό (χαράσσω, to engrave), __(a) a stamp, impress, mark : Rev.13:16-17 14:9, 11 16:2 19:20 20:4 (see Deiss., BS, 240 ff.); __(b) a thing graven : Act.17:29. † (AS)

g5483.definition: χαρίζομαι (χάρις), [in LXX: Est.8:7 (נָתַן), Sng.1:4 א, Sir.12:3 , 2 - 4Ma.9:1-32 * ;] __1. to show favour or kindness : with dative of person(s), Gal.3:18. __2. to give freely, bestow : with accusative and dative, Luk.7:21 , Act.3:14 25:11, 16 27:24 , Rom.8:32 , 1Co.2:12 , Php.1:29 2:9 , Phm 22. __3. g5485.definition: χάρις, -ιτος, ἡ Abbott-Smith does not include the article here. , accusative, χάριν (χάριτα in Act.24:27 , Ju 4 ; see WH, App. , 157), [in LXX chiefly for חֵן ;] __1. objectively, that which causes favourable regard, gracefulness, grace, loveliness of form, graciousness of speech (cl.; Ecc.10:12 , Sir.21:16 , al.)…

g5486.definition: χάρισμα , -τος, τό (χαρίζομαι) [in LXX: Sir.7:33 א (AB, χάρις) Sir.38:30 Bl (א AB2R, χρῖσμα) * ;] a gift of grace, a free gift, esp. of extra­ordinary operations of the Spirit in the Apostolic Church, but including all spiritual graces and endowments (Lft., Notes , 148 f.): Rom.1:11 5:15-16 6:23 11:29 12:6 , 1Co.1:7…

g5487.definition: χαριτόω , -ῶ (χάρις), [in LXX: Sir.18:17 (ἀνδρί κεχαριτωμένῳ; Vg., justificato; Syr., saintly) * ;] to endow with χάρις (which see), i.e. __1. (a) to make graceful; __(b) to make gracious (Sir, l.with). __2. In Hellenistic writings (for exx., see AR, Eph. , 227; Lft., Notes , 315), __(a) to cause to find favour…

g5488.definition: χαρράν indecl. (in FlJ., Ant. , i, 16, 1, Κάρρα, -ας, ib. 6, 5, Χαρρά, -ᾶς; so LXX: Gen.29:4 E, Eze.27:28 B, elsewhere -άν­Heb. חָרָן), Haran, a town in N.W. Mesopotamia: Act.7:2 , 4.† (AS)

g5489.definition: χάρτης , -ου, ὁ [in LXX: Isa.8:1 A, Jer.36:2, 6 36:23 (מְגִלָּה) * ;] a sheet of paper, made of papyrus strips (see Kennedy, Sources , 42; Milligan, NTD , 10-12; DB , iv, 945 f.): II Jn 12 (Plat., Inscr.).† (AS)

g5490.definition: χάσμα , -τος, τό (χάσκω, to yawn), [in LXX: 2Ki.18:17 (פַּחַת)* ;] a chasm, wide space : Luk.16:26. † (AS)

g5491.definition: χεῖλος , -ους, τό, genitive pl., -εων (see Bl., § 8, 4; Thackeray, Gr. , I, 151), [in LXX chiefly for שָׂפָה ;] a lip (as in Heb. , of the lip as the organ of speech): Mat.15:8 , Mrk.7:6 , Rom.3:13 , 1Co.14:21 , Heb.13:15 , 1Pe.3:10 " (LXX) . Metaphorical, of things, an edge, brink, etc. (Hom., Hdt., al.): of the…

g5492.definition: χειμάζω (χεῖμα, winter cold) [in LXX: Pro.26:10 (†) * ;] __1. to expose to winter cold, go into winter quarters. __2. to drive with storm ; pass., to be driven with storm, tempest-tossed : Act.27:18. † (AS)

g5493.definition: χείμμαρος (shortened form of the more usual -οος, Attic contr., -ους), -ον (χεῖμα, ῥέω) [in LXX chiefly for נַחַל ;] winter-flowing ; as subst., ὁ χ. (sc. ποταμός), a torrent : Jhn.18:1. † (AS)

g5494.definition: χειμών , -ῶνος, ὁ [in LXX for גֶּשֶׁם, סְתָו ;] __1. winter : Jhn.10:22 , 2Ti.4:21 ; genitive, χειμῶνος, in winter, Mat.24:20 , Mrk.13:18 . __2. Prop., a winter storm, hence, generally, a storm, tempest : Mat.16:3 (T, WH, R, mg., om.), Act.27:20. † (AS)

g5495.definition: χείρ , genitive, χειρος (accusative, χεῖραν, 1Pe.5:6 T), ἡ, [in LXX chiefly for יָד ;] the hand : Mat.3:12 , Mrk.3:1 , Luk.6:6 , al. mult.; ἡ χ., acting subject, Luk.22:21; pl., Act.17:25 20:34 , 1Jn.1:1 ; τ. ἔργα τῶν χ., Act.7:41 , Rev.9:20 ; ὁ ἀσπασμὸς τ. ἐμῇ χ., 1Co.16:21 , Col.4:18 , 2Th.3:17 ; prepositional…

g5496.definition: χειραγωγέω , -ῶ (χειραγωγός), [in LXX: Jdg.16:26 A (יָד חָזַק), Tob.11:16 א * ;] to lead by the hand : Act.9:8 22:11 .† (AS)

g5498.definition: χειρόγραφος , -ον (χείρ, γράφω), [in LXX: Tob.5:3 9:2, 5 * ;] written with the hand. As subst., τὸ χ., a handwriting (Inscr., Polyb., al.): metaphorically, Col.2:14. † (AS)

g5499.definition: χειρο-ποίητος , -ον (χείρ, ποιέω), [in LXX (of idols) for אֱלִיל ;] made by hand (i.e. of human handiwork): of temples, Mrk.14:58 , Act.7:48 17:24 , Heb.9:11, 24 ; of circumcision, Eph.2:11. † (AS)

g5500.definition: χειρο-τονέω , -ῶ (χείρ, τείνω) __1. to vote by stretching out the hand in the Athenian ἐκκλησία (Luc., Plut.). __2. to appoint : __(a) by vote, 2Co.8:19 __(b) without vote, Act.14:23 (see Rackham, in l) (cf. προχειροτονέω).† (AS)

g5501.definition: χείρων , -ον, compar. of κακός [in LXX: 1Ki.17:43 B, Wis.15:18 17:6 , 3Ma.5:20 * ;] worse : Mat.9:16 12:45 27:64 , Mrk.2:21 , Luk.11:26 , Jhn.5:14 , 1Ti.5:8 , Heb.10:29 , 2Pe.2:20 ; εἰς (ἐπὶ) τὸ χεῖρον, Mrk.5:26 , 2Ti.3:13 .† (AS)

g5502.definition: Χερουβείν (Rec. -βίμ), τά (Heb. כְּרוּב), Cherubim : Heb.9:6 (cf. Exo.25:17 (18), al.; see DB , i, 377 ff.).† (AS)

g5503.definition: χήρα , -ας, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for אַלְמָנָה ;] a widow : Mat.23:13 (Rec., R, mg.), Mrk.12:40-43 , Luk.2:37 4:25 7:12 18:3, 5 20:47 21:2-3 , Act.6:1 9:39, 41 , 1Co.7:8 , 1Ti.5:3-5 5:11 5:16 , Jas.1:27 ; γυνὴ χ., Luk.4:26; of one of an ordo viduarum (see CGT, in l), 1Ti.5:9; metaphorically, of a city forsaken, Rev.18:7.…

g5504.definition: ἐχθές (Rec. χθές), adv., [in LXX for תְּמוֹל, etc. ;] yesterday : Jhn.4:52 , Act.7:28 , Heb.13:8 (on the form, see Rutherford, NPhr. , 370 f.).† ἐχθές , adverb ={χθές}, yesterday , ( 5th-6th c.BC: Aristophanes Comicus “Nubes” 175, “Th.” 616, etc.; ἀπ᾽ ἐ. “Anthologia Graeca” 11.35 (1st c.BC: Philodemus Gadarensis…

g5505.definition: χιλιάς , -άδος, ἡ (χίλιοι), [in LXX for אֶלֶף ;] the number one thousand, a thousand : Luk.14:31 , Act.4:4 , 1Co.10:8 , Rev.5:11 7:4-8 11:13 14:1, 3 21:16 .† (AS)

g5506.definition: χιλίαρχος (in Hdt., al., -ης), -ου, ὁ (χίλιοι, ἄρχω) [in LXX chiefly for אַלּוּף שַׂר ;] a chiliarch, the commander of a thousand, esp. a Roman military tribune, the commander of a cohort: Jhn.18:12 , Act.21:31-33, 37 22:24-29 23:10, 15 23:17-19, 22 24:7, 22 25:23 ; more generally, of officers of similar rank…

g5508.definition: χίος , -ου, ἡ Chios, an island in Ægean Sea : Act.20:15. † (AS)

g5509.definition: χιτών , ῶνος, ὁ [in LXX chiefly for כְּתֹנֶת:] the garment worn next the skin (though two tunics were sometimes worn, see Swete, Mk. , 117), a tunic : Mat.10:10 , Mrk.6:9 14:63 , Luk.3:11 9:3 , Ju 23 ; dieting. from ἱμάτιον (which see), Mat.5:40 , Luk.6:29 , Jhn.19:23 , Act.9:39 (see DCG , i, 338, 340, 499) (AS)

g5510.definition: χιών , -όνος, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for שֶׁלֶג also (in Da) for תְּלַג ;] snow : Mat.28:3 , Rev.1:14 .† (AS)

g5511.definition: χλαμύς , -ύδος, ἡ [in LXX: 2Ma.12:35 * ;] a chlamys, or short cloak worn over the χιτών (which see): Mat.27:28, 31 (see Tr., Syn. , § 1).† (AS)

g5512.definition: χλευάζω (χλεύη, a jest), [in LXX: Wis.11:14 , 2Ma.7:7 , 4Ma.5:22 * ;] to jest, mock, jeer : Act.17:32. † (AS)

g5513.definition: χλιαρός , -ά, -όν (χλίω, to become warm), warm, tepid ; metaphorically, of persons, luke-warm : Rev.3:16. † (AS)
